% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。

references.excerpt: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。

召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。

abaddon_aphotic_shield.excerpt: Aphotic Shield

Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Damage barrier amount increased, but no longer bursts upon expiration. %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies. Increases cooldown.
%absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
无光之盾

召唤黑暗能量环绕友方单位，驱散他们并创造一个<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>，<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>在消失前能吸收一定量的伤害。<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>消失或被摧毁后将会爆炸，对附近区域的单位造成伤害，伤害值为<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>的最大吸收量。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
伤害护盾数值提升，但是护盾被摧毁后不再爆炸。%absorb_to_damage%%%吸收伤害会反弹给附近的敌人。增加冷却时间。
会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的%absorb_to_damage%%%。
不论护盾因持续时间结束或吸收足够伤害后被摧毁都将造成最大伤害。
爆炸将不会对战争迷雾内单位造成伤害。

abaddon_borrowed_time.excerpt: Borrowed Time

When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
While Borrowed Time is active, Abaddon and enemies within %immolate_aoe% radius take %immolate_damage% damage per second.

Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than %ally_threshold_scepter% damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.
Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
回光返照
启动后驱散自身，所有受到的伤害转而产生<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。只要技能不在冷却中，在生命值低于%hp_threshold%点时技能会自动启动。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
回光返照生效时亚巴顿和%immolate_aoe%范围内的敌人每秒会受到%immolate_damage%点伤害。
提升持续时间。启动回光返照后，亚巴顿附近迷雾缠绕的施法距离内友方英雄受到的伤害超过%ally_threshold_scepter%点时亚巴顿就会自动对其施放迷雾缠绕。
在亚巴顿受到眩晕作用时依然可以手动开启回光返照，但是受到沉默作用时不可以。不过被沉默时被动效果依然能生效。
无光之盾在回光返照生效期间不会吸收伤害，因此也不会影响治疗效果。
破坏会使回光返照无法自动触发。

abaddon_death_coil.excerpt: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
Mist Coil also deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% attack damage and applies effects from items and abilities. Self Damage increased when targeting enemies.
Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友方单位。
迷雾缠绕还会造成%damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%%攻击伤害，并且施加物品和技能的效果。对敌人施放时对自身的伤害增加。
亚巴顿不能使用此技能自杀。

abaddon_frostmourne.excerpt: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%%。

abaddon_withering_mist.excerpt: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%%% HP.
对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续%duration%秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于%hp_threshold_pct%%%，那么生命回复会降低%heal_reduction_pct%%%。

abyssal_underling_archer_aoe.excerpt: 提升周围单位的移动速度。

abyssal_underlord_abyssal_horde.excerpt:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every %underling_spawn_interval%s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

穿过恶魔之扉后，在恶魔之扉持续时间内每%underling_spawn_interval%秒孽主就会召唤一个战士或一个射手来援助他。

战士每次攻击都会燃烧魔法，并且对击杀它的单位造成魔法伤害。射手拥有被动移速光环。

abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.excerpt: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
Underlord's attacks cleave while he has bonus damage from Atrophy Aura.
Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
孽主在拥有衰退光环的攻击力加成时攻击具有分裂效果。
破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.excerpt: Fiend's Gate
Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

Underlord summons uncontrollable demonic Warriors and Archers after travelling through the Fiend's Gate that attack nearby enemies. These units deal %underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%% damage to buildings.

Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
恶魔之扉
在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。
孽主穿过恶魔之扉后会召唤不可控的恶魔战士和射手，攻击附近敌人。这些单位对建筑造成%underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%%伤害。
打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法%warp_channel_duration%秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过%minimum_distance%。
双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。

abyssal_underlord_firestorm.excerpt: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.
召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。

abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.excerpt: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.
Increases radius of the Pit of Malice.
在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。每个敌方单位每隔%pit_interval%秒才会再次受到作用。
提升怨念深渊的作用范围。

alchemist_acid_spray.excerpt: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。

alchemist_goblins_greed.excerpt: Greevil's Greed

Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
Alchemist gains %gpm_increase_per_stack% GPM for each Aghanim's Scepter he has granted to allies.

Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

Chemical Rage Aghanim's Scepter has been moved to Greevil's Greed for Ability Draft. Use Aghanim's Scepter on an allied hero to grant them all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. When you have a Scepter of your own, you will gain bonus damage and spell amplification for each gifted Scepter.
贪魔的贪婪
炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
炼金术士每对友军送出一把阿哈利姆神杖就获得%gpm_increase_per_stack%每分钟金钱。
炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。
化学狂暴的神杖升级效果在技能征召中已移至贪魔的贪婪。对一名友方英雄使用阿哈利姆神杖可以使他们获得相应的神杖升级效果。而自身拥有神杖后，根据送出的神杖数量将获得额外攻击力和技能增强。

alchemist_unstable_concoction_throw.excerpt: Throw it before it blows up!

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.excerpt: Ice Blast

Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
冰晶爆轰
向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。
施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。

antimage_counterspell_ally.excerpt: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.

Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.
法术反制会使施法者被燃烧该技能魔法消耗的一定百分比，并且造成%damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%%燃烧魔法的伤害，最高为每次反弹技能造成%max_damage_from_mana_drain%点伤害。
在附近一个友军目标周围制造一个反魔法外壳，抵挡并反弹所有指向性技能。法术反制或友军法术反制抵挡技能后，都会在敌人身旁产生一个敌法师的幻象。

antimage_mana_break.excerpt: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。
幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为%illusion_percentage%%%。

antimage_mana_void.excerpt: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.

Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.
Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

敌方英雄的魔法值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%时会被动提供攻击力，而且魔法值越低，提升效果越大。

如果敌人的魔法值低于%threshold_pct%%%，敌法师获得攻击力加成的最大值，以及该英雄的视野和真实视域。会施加给%thirst_range%范围内的敌方英雄。每个英雄提供的加成效果可以叠加。
伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。

antimage_persectur.excerpt: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
Full effect if caused by illusions.
攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。%mana_threshold%%%魔法时造成最低减速，0%%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于%mana_threshold%%%魔法时没有效果。

arc_warden_flux.excerpt: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.
将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
目标落单时乱流具有<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

arc_warden_magnetic_field.excerpt: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
Magnetic Field pulls runes. Runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。
磁场会牵引神符。磁场内的神符会自动激活。

arc_warden_runic_infusion.excerpt: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。

arc_warden_spark_wraith.excerpt: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.
召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。

arc_warden_tempest_double.excerpt: Tempest Double

Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.

The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.

The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
风暴双雄

天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。

复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。

风暴双雄产生时带有强化神符的加成效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

1级 - 奥术神符。

2级 - 奥术和隐身神符。

3级 - 奥术、隐身和极速神符。

风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

不会触发神符灌注。
复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。

attribute_bonus.excerpt: Improves all attributes per point spent
消耗技能点提升所有属性

axe_battle_hunger.excerpt: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。
摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。

axe_berserkers_call.excerpt: Berserker's Call
Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.
Must draft Battle Hunger for Scepter upgrade to work.
狂战士之吼
斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。
狂战士之吼提供的护甲更高，而且增加了受作用单位的攻击速度。
必须拥有战斗饥渴才会具有神杖升级效果。

axe_counter_helix.excerpt: Counter Helix
After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
反击螺旋
受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。
反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。

axe_culling_blade.excerpt: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.\n\nAxe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。\n\n每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

backdoor_protection.excerpt: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.
只要附近没有敌方的小兵，建筑所受的伤害就会有一定的减免，而且会快速恢复生命值。

backdoor_protection_in_base.excerpt: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.
只要附近没有敌方的小兵，建筑所受的伤害就会有一定的减免，而且会快速恢复生命值。

bane_enfeeble.excerpt: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。

bane_ichor_of_nyctasha.excerpt: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.
每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>减少。

bane_nightmare.excerpt: Nightmare
Hero that drafts Nightmare can continue to attack Nightmared units. Bane can also attack even if he didn't draft this ability.

Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.
In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
噩梦
拥有技能“噩梦”的英雄可以攻击噩梦作用下的单位。祸乱之源即使没有该技能也能攻击。

让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
祸乱之源在攻击噩梦中单位时获得额外的攻击速度。
噩梦中单位会朝选定方向走去。
在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。

batrider_flamebreak.excerpt: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。

batrider_flaming_lasso.excerpt: Flaming Lasso
Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
燃烧枷锁
用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近%grab_radius_scepter%范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。
杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。

batrider_sticky_napalm.excerpt: Sticky Napalm

Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
Increases the max level of Sticky Napalm. Level %max_level_tooltip% Sticky Napalm causes every attack to apply %napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip% stack of Sticky Napalm.
All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.

Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
粘性燃油
用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
提升粘性燃油的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级粘性燃油会使每次攻击施加%napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip%层粘性燃油。
所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。

粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。

粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

beastmaster_drums_of_slom.excerpt:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.

兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。

使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。

beastmaster_primal_roar.excerpt: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.
兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。

beastmaster_summon_raptor.excerpt: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.
兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

beastmaster_summon_razorback.excerpt: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。

beastmaster_wild_axes.excerpt: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

bloodseeker_blood_bath.excerpt: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.
血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。%delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip%秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
总时间为%delay%秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。

bloodseeker_bloodrage.excerpt: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as <font color=\"#d8ae53\">Pure</font> damage.
使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成%max_health_dmg_pct%%%目标最大生命值的<font color=\"#d8ae53\">纯粹</font>伤害。

bloodseeker_rupture.excerpt: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.
让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
提升初始伤害，并且提供%AbilityCharges%点割裂能量点数。

bloodseeker_sanguivore.excerpt:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础%base_heal%点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。

友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
非英雄单位的吸血效果减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.excerpt: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

bounty_hunter_track.excerpt: Track

Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.
追踪术
追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>。
只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.excerpt: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
赏金猎人进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。
开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

brewmaster_cinder_brew.excerpt:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
Cinder Brew is now a rolling barrel of ale that drenches enemies in its path and explodes at the end.

向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。

路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加%extra_duration%秒，并且受到持续伤害。
余烬佳酿现在是装满酒的滚动酒桶，会使路径上的敌人浸满酒，并且在终点爆炸。

brewmaster_drunken_brawler.excerpt:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。

每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升%brewed_up_bonus%%%，持续%brewed_up_duration%秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长%brewed_up_duration_extend%秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，%hangover_time%秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。

大地拳法 - 获得护甲和魔法抗性加成。

狂风拳法 - 获得闪避和移动速度加成。

烈火拳法 - 获得攻击速度加成，并且拥有几率造成致命一击伤害。
与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

brewmaster_primal_split.excerpt: Primal Split

Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.

Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
元素分离
酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。

元素分离获得%scepter_bonus_levels%级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。

元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。
大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。

bristleback_bristleback.excerpt: Bristleback
Quill Spray must be drafted also to release when damage threshold reached.
Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
钢毛后背
必须拥有技能“刺针扫射”才会在伤害触发临界值后生效。
如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
他受到伤害时不再释放刺针扫射，而是对附近所有敌人发射当前等级的粘稠鼻液。
钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，%activation_delay%秒后以%activation_spray_interval%秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出%activation_num_quill_sprays%次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓%activation_movement_speed_pct%%%。

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.excerpt: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
用鼻涕包裹一个敌方单位，降低护甲和移动速度，持续%goo_duration%秒。多次施放的效果会叠加，并且刷新持续时间。
提升了最大叠加层数和每层护甲降低。

bristleback_warpath.excerpt: Warpath
Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.
Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.
战意
钢背兽每次使用技能时都会进入狂暴状态，移动速度和攻击力都将提升。
战意提供攻击速度加成，而不只有攻击力。
钢背兽的幻象也能继承加成效果。
使用物品不会触发战意。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
战意可以主动开启，获得额外的攻击力和移动速度加成，持续较短时间。红光满面期间，钢背兽的视野减少至狭窄的锥形，并且不会获得友军的视野。

broodmother_insatiable_hunger.excerpt: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
Insatiable Hunger also applies to nearby Spiderlings.
While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.
对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
极度饥渴还会施加给附近的小蜘蛛。
开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。

broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.excerpt: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.
育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。

broodmother_spin_web.excerpt:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
Reduces health restoration of enemies on webs that are in the same web network as Broodmother.

编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。

织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
减少育母蜘蛛所在蛛网上敌人的生命回复。

centaur_horsepower.excerpt:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为%strength_to_movement_pct%%%自身力量值。

这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。

centaur_return.excerpt: Retaliate
Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
反伤
半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

centaur_stampede.excerpt: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。

centaur_work_horse.excerpt: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.excerpt: Chaos Bolt
Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.
The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
混乱之箭
对目标单位投掷一支神秘的能量箭。造成随机时间的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和随机的伤害。
混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象造成的伤害减少%illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%%。
眩晕持续时间和伤害值为负相关。
附近的幻象也会模仿施法动作。

chaos_knight_phantasm.excerpt: Phantasm

Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
混沌之军
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。\n驱散类型：弱驱散

增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。

施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。
能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。

chaos_knight_reality_rift.excerpt: Reality Rift
Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.
Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
实相裂隙
将混沌骑士及混沌骑士的幻象和目标单位传送到混沌骑士与目标连线上的一点。降低敌方单位的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
实相裂隙可以对自身或幻象1200范围内的任意敌方英雄施放。自身英雄和所有幻象会集合，并传送至敌方目标处。
实相裂隙除了平常效果外，还有均等几率施加破坏、缴械或沉默，持续时间为基础负面效果时间的%additional_debuff_duration_percent%%%。
目标单位将会强制面向混沌骑士，而且混沌骑士和幻象默认对目标发动攻击。

chen_divine_favor.excerpt: Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.\n\nIf cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和生命恢复增强。\n\n对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。

chen_hand_of_god.excerpt: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.

Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。

上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。
可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。

chen_holy_persuasion.excerpt: Holy Persuasion

Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to %health_min%. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.
Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
Max number of Ancient creeps controllable equal to level of ultimate.
Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
神圣劝化
陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为%health_min%。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在%unsummon_time%秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。
远古生物的最大可控数量等于终极技能的等级。
如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。

chen_zealot.excerpt:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy. The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage. The Zealot respawns next to Chen after %zealot_respawn_time%s.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay. If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈复活%zealot_respawn_time%秒后在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

clinkz_bone_and_arrow.excerpt: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.
克林克兹死亡时会召唤一个骷髅弓手。

clinkz_burning_barrage.excerpt: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.
持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。

clinkz_death_pact.excerpt: Death Pact
Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
Death Pact teleports Clinkz towards his victim. Reduces Death Pact cooldown. If Alt-Cast behavior is activated, or Clinkz is Rooted or Leashed, he will not teleport to the target location.
Searing Arrows must also be drafted for Burning Army archers to have the extra damage.
If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
死亡契约
克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
死亡契约会把克林克兹传送至目标。降低死亡契约的充能时间。如果设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），或者克林克兹被缠绕或束缚，那他就不会传送至目标地点。
必须拥有技能“灼热之箭”才能使骷髅弓手拥有额外伤害。
如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。

clinkz_searing_arrows.excerpt:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。

骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成%skeleton_damage_pct%%%伤害。
灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。

clinkz_tar_bomb.excerpt:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for %ground_duration% seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.

克林克兹对敌方目标扔出一个涂满焦油的弹道，击中时造成魔法伤害。击中后焦油会溅到地上，并留在地面上，持续%ground_duration%秒。经过的敌人都会被减速，并且受到来自克林克兹或他的骷髅弓手的攻击都会承受额外物理伤害。

焦油炸弹击中时，攻击距离内的骷髅弓手都会攻击该目标。如果设为自动施放，克林克兹会在技能可用的情况下攻击目标时扔出焦油炸弹。

clinkz_wind_walk.excerpt:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.

克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低%skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。

creep_siege.excerpt: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.
坚锐单位和建筑对其他坚锐单位和建筑造成额外伤害，并且受到其他单位的伤害变低。

crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.excerpt:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.

地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近%proximity_bonus_radius%范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。

水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
主动开启奥术光环会临时提升水晶室女的技能增强，但技能的魔法消耗也会增加。在持续时间内，只要水晶室女施放技能，她和她的友军都会回复魔法。不会影响物品。极寒领域的持续施法期间持续时间会暂停。

crystal_maiden_crystal_clone.excerpt: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近%frostbite_radius%范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.excerpt: Freezing Field
CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval% seconds.

Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
Frostbite must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.
极寒领域
持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤100次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
每%explosion_interval%秒产生一次爆炸。
使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。
必须拥有技能“冰封禁制”才能使神杖升级效果生效。

dark_seer_normal_punch.excerpt: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.
被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去%recent_duration%秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。移动%max_distance%距离以上将造成最大威力。

dark_seer_surge.excerpt: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.

Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。
奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。

dark_seer_vacuum.excerpt: Vacuum
Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.
真空
黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为%duration%秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。

dark_seer_wall_of_replica.excerpt: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

dark_troll_warlord_ensnare.excerpt: The Dark Troll Summoner tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.
黑暗巨魔召唤法师向一个敌人脚下扔出诱捕网，使他暂时无法移动，被网住的单位仍然可以攻击和使用技能。

dark_troll_warlord_raise_dead.excerpt: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.
黑暗巨魔召唤法师搅动脚下的大地，从死亡巨魔的尸体中招出三个骷髅战士为他作战。

dark_willow_bedlam.excerpt: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。

dark_willow_bramble_maze.excerpt: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
%initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
缠绕无法打断持续施法。

dark_willow_cursed_crown.excerpt: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

While ticking, Cursed Crown accumulates %accumulated_damage_pct%%% of all damage dealt by Dark Willow and %accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%% of attack damage dealt by allied heroes. When the counter ends, the accumulated damage is dealt again as magical damage to the whole area. This triggers even upon dispel with Aghanim's Shard.
邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。
倒计时期间诅咒王冠会累计邪影芳灵对目标造成所有伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct%%%，还有友方英雄对其造成攻击伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%%。倒计时结束时，累计的伤害会作为魔法伤害施加给整个区域。拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后，可以在技能被驱散时触发。

dark_willow_pixie_dust.excerpt: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.
邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。

dark_willow_shadow_realm.excerpt: Shadow Realm

Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.

While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.
Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
暗影之境
邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
处于暗影之境时，邪影芳灵会散发出一个%aura_radius%范围的光环，使她对范围内的敌人造成的伤害增加，最高为%aura_damage_pct%%%。根据她在暗影之境内停留的时间，造成的伤害会随之增加。
发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。
施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。

dark_willow_terrorize.excerpt: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
Terrorize provides vision on affected units.
邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.excerpt: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.excerpt: Celestial Hammer

When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.

Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
Enemies hit by Celestial Hammer will count as Luminosity attacks. Luminosity's crit will apply to Celestial Hammer.
上界重锤
上界重锤停在地面时，会产生天光现世的治疗和伤害效果，数值减少%hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%%，作用于重锤附近%hammer_solar_guardian_radius%范围。重锤的停留时间提升至%pause_duration%秒。
破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留%pause_duration%秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。
友方英雄在上界重锤的炽烈之径上行走会获得移动速度加成。
上界重锤击中敌人时会视为熠熠生辉的攻击。熠熠生辉的暴击效果会施加给上界重锤。

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.excerpt: Starbreaker
Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.

Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.
星破天惊
破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。
破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。
在星破天惊结束后每次破晓辰星挥击和锤击敌方英雄都会使%movespeed_bonus_radius%范围内她和所有友军获得攻击速度加成，持续%movespeed_bonus_duration%秒。

dawnbreaker_luminosity.excerpt: Luminosity

After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
熠熠生辉
破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>她附近%heal_radius%范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为%allied_healing_pct%%%。
Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
只要破晓辰星击中目标时触发了熠熠生辉的强化攻击，她所有技能的冷却时间都会减少。
熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.excerpt: Solar Guardian

CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
天光现世

持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。
天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

dazzle_innate_weave.excerpt: Weave
Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
Weave applies %enemy_multiplier%x stacks to enemies.
编织
戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。
编织会对友军施加%ally_multiplier%倍叠加层数。编织的每层叠加效果会使来自戴泽的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果增强%heal_amplification_pct%%%。
编织会对敌人施加%enemy_multiplier%倍叠加层数。

dazzle_nothl_projection.excerpt: Nothl Projection

Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
虚无投影

戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：
剧毒之触带有妖术效果；
薄葬结束时会治疗；
暗影波的冷却时间变短。

效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。

dazzle_poison_touch.excerpt: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

dazzle_shadow_wave.excerpt: Shadow Wave
Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
暗影波
放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

dazzle_shallow_grave.excerpt: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.excerpt: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

death_prophet_exorcism.excerpt: Exorcism

Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
驱使恶灵
释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。
作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.excerpt: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.
Cannot cast multiple on same target.
创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
吸魂巫术的能量点数提升%shard_bonus_charges%点，敌人连续%shard_consecutive_siphon_duration%秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>%shard_fear_duration%秒。
多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。

disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.excerpt: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.
每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。

disruptor_kinetic_fence.excerpt: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。

disruptor_kinetic_field.excerpt: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
Both shapes have an independent cooldown.
在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
力场不能困住减益免疫单位。
Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

disruptor_thunder_strike.excerpt: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.

Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
风雷之击还会额外打击动能力场内所有敌人。风雷之击的减速时间提升至%slow_duration%秒。
提升风雷之击的施法距离和打击次数。还可以对地施放，使风雷之击先潜伏最多%shard_ground_delay%秒，并附着到第一个进入作用范围的敌人身上。

doom_bringer_devour.excerpt: Devour
Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
Devour will only acquire the passive abilities that the creep possessed. If Rearm is drafted and cast, this ability's cooldown will not be reset.
Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
吞噬
消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。
吞噬只会获取非英雄单位拥有的被动技能。若同时拥有再装填技能，施放后该技能的冷却时间不会重置。
末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。

doom_bringer_doom.excerpt: Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.

Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其<font color='#6db6e9'>无法施放技能</font>或获得任何<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果，同时造成持续伤害。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
末日的持续时间每%upgrade_interval%分钟都会提升%upgrade_amount%秒。
末日对敌人施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

doom_bringer_scorched_earth.excerpt: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.
用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.excerpt: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.excerpt: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.excerpt:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。

1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。

2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。

3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

drow_ranger_glacier.excerpt:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。

山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。

drow_ranger_multishot.excerpt:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。

卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.excerpt: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
释放一阵狂风，<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。

earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.excerpt: Geomagnetic Grip

Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
Requires Magnetize to also be drafted to utilize stone remnants.
地磁之握

大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。

拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。

以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
冷却时间减少至%AbilityCooldown%秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。
如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。
同时拥有磁化才能使用残岩。

earth_spirit_magnetize.excerpt: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
Magnetizing a Stone Remnant gives Earth Spirit bonus attack damage for %magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration% seconds. Does not stack.
Also grants Stone Remnant ability. Acquiring Scepter will grant the Enchant Remnant ability.
将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。
磁化一个残岩会让大地之灵获得攻击力加成，持续%magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration%秒。不会叠加。
另外获得技能“残岩”。拥有神杖后获得技能“残岩魔咒”。

earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.excerpt: Rolling Boulder

Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
Stone Remnants are not destroyed when rolled over, and the cooldown of Stone Remnant is refreshed when the roll is done.

Rolling over an allied hero grants the allied hero and Earth Spirit %allied_bonus_movespeed%%% bonus movespeed for %allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%s. If he rolls over an allied hero, Earth Spirit will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer,
Stone Remnant combination require drafting Magnetize to get the Stone Remnants.
Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
巨石翻滚
大地之灵化身为巨石，经过%delay%秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，伤害值为%damage% + %damage_str%%%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间更长。
残岩在翻滚时经过不会被摧毁，而且翻滚结束后残岩的冷却时间会重置。
滚过一名友方英雄后会使该友方英雄和大地之灵获得%allied_bonus_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，持续%allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%秒。而且滚过友方英雄时，大地之灵滚动的距离变远，速度变快，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人的时间也变长。
残岩的技能组合需要拥有磁化才能获得技能“残岩”。
翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
巨石的作用范围为%radius%。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。

earth_spirit_stone_caller.excerpt:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
Has a fixed cooldown instead of charges.

在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。

每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。
拥有固定的冷却时间，而不是能量点数。

earthshaker_echo_slam.excerpt: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。

earthshaker_enchant_totem.excerpt: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。
强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。

earthshaker_fissure.excerpt: Fissure
Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.
Requires drafting Aftershock for Shard upgrade to work.
沟壑
用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>的时间有所降低。
被沟壑击中的敌方英雄会对%echoes_radius%范围内附近每个单位释放一道回音，造成的伤害等同于回音击的%echoes_damage_multiplier%%%当前回音伤害。
必须拥有余震才会具有魔晶升级效果。

earthshaker_slugger.excerpt: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.
利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。

elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.excerpt: Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.\n\nThe Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。\n\n灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

elder_titan_earth_splitter.excerpt: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
上古巨神向前方放出一道不平坦的裂纹。3秒后裂纹塌陷，范围内的单位将被减速，并受到基于他们自身生命最大值的伤害。其中一半伤害为魔法伤害，另一半为物理伤害。

elder_titan_echo_stomp.excerpt: Echo Stomp

CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
Echo Stomp will still apply both the physical and magical damage values regardless of Astral Spirit being drafted.
If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
回音重踏
持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。
不论是否拥有技能“灵体游魂”，回音重踏都会同时造成物理和魔法伤害。
若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。

elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit.excerpt: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.  Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.
上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。昏迷的敌人受到伤害会被惊醒。

elder_titan_momentum.excerpt: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.
上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant.excerpt: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。

ember_spirit_fire_remnant.excerpt: Fire Remnant

Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
残焰
可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的%speed_multiplier%%%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。
提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。
学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。
