Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
战神迅矛
玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。

medusa_gorgon_grasp.excerpt: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
美杜莎沿着一条直线射出%volley_count%组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。

medusa_mana_shield.excerpt: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%. Maximum effect reached after %aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%s. Buff lasts %aspd_increase_buff_duration%s and Cooldown is %attack_buff_cooldown%s.
创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收%absorption_pct%%%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少%illusion_percentage%%%。
伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。

魔法盾可以主动开启，每秒消耗%aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%%最大魔法值并每秒获得%aspd_increase_rate_pct%%%攻击速度加成，最高为%aspd_increase_max_tooltip%。%aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%秒后获得最大效果。加成状态持续%aspd_increase_buff_duration%秒。冷却时间为%attack_buff_cooldown%秒。

medusa_mystic_snake.excerpt: Mystic Snake

A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.
Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.

Shard: Cold Blooded is hidden in the ability panel when Shard is aquired, but a buff icon will appear.

Stone Gaze must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.
秘术异蛇
放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
秘术异蛇返回至美杜莎后，根据异蛇回复的魔法值，每%mana_per_damage%点魔法都会使她接下来的%max_attacks%次攻击附带+1 额外伤害。加成状态持续最多%attack_buff_duration%秒。
秘术异蛇无法躲避。

魔晶： 获得魔晶后冷血动物会在技能栏中隐藏，但是会显示状态图标。

必须拥有石化凝视才会具有神杖升级效果。

medusa_split_shot.excerpt: Split Shot

Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
分裂箭

美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。

额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。
次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

meepo_divided_we_stand.excerpt:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.

米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。

来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。

任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。
现在可以在%required_level%级时学习，之后每%bonus_levels_between_upgrades%级可以再升级一次，最高为%max_level%级。米波克隆体获得米波本体%main_meepo_stats_pct%%%的额外属性。
所有米波都拥有可叠加的光环，提升附近米波%support_group_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度和%support_group_armor%点护甲。作用范围：%support_radius%。

meepo_earthbind.excerpt: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.
向目标地点扔出一张网，<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>区域内所有敌方单位。
地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。

meepo_fling.excerpt:
Pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming yourself and disabling them. Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped after %hold_duration% seconds.

Pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming yourself and disabling them. Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped after %hold_duration% seconds.

meepo_megameepo.excerpt: Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.\n\n When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.
主米波将%radius%范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波%stats_pct%%%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。\n\n生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外%poof_damage_factor%%%伤害。

meepo_megameepo_fling.excerpt: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。

meepo_pack_rat.excerpt: Pack Rat
All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.
Most items except for Consumables, Hand of Midas, and Divine Rapier can be equipped in the neutral item slot.
Using the item on one Meepo puts it on cooldown for all other Meepos for %cooldown_pct%%% of the regular cooldown.
Certain passive abilities and effects on items have reduced or no effectiveness.
囤积狂鼠
所有米波都可以使用中立物品栏位中的物品。
除了消耗品、迈达斯之手和圣剑以外，大多数物品都可以装备在中立物品栏。
一个米波使用物品都会使其他米波身上的该物品进入冷却状态，时间为%cooldown_pct%%%平常冷却时间。
某些物品的被动技能和效果有所降低，或者没有实际效果

meepo_poof.excerpt: Poof

Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
In AD, can poof to any friendly unit within 2000 range.
Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.
忽悠

通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。

如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
在技能征召中可以对2000范围内任意友方单位施放忽悠。
可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

meepo_sticky_fingers.excerpt: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.
打造中立物品时额外拥有一个选项。

miniboss_alleviation.excerpt: After death, the Tormentor leaves behind a verdant dale, increasing the regeneration of everyone nearby by %hp_restoration_pct%%% of their Max Health.
痛苦魔方被消灭后留下一片青翠的山谷，使附近所有人的生命恢复提升，数值为各自最大生命值的%hp_restoration_pct%%%。

miniboss_radiance.excerpt: Deals %aura_damage% damage to all units within %aura_radius% range every second for %attack_timer_duration%s once attacked or damaged.
只要受到攻击或伤害就会每秒对%aura_radius%范围内所有单位造成%aura_damage%点伤害，持续%attack_timer_duration%秒。

miniboss_reflect.excerpt: Reflects damage received evenly to the attacker and all other heroes within 1200 radius
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
所有的伤害都会反弹，均摊给1200范围内的攻击者以及其他所有英雄
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

miniboss_unyielding_shield.excerpt: Passively grants a regenerating All Damage Barrier. Armor can not go below 0.
被动提供持续恢复的全伤害护盾。护甲不会低于0。

mirana_arrow.excerpt: Sacred Arrow

Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
月神之箭

射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。目标距离越远，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。
神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。

mirana_solar_flare.excerpt:
Gradually increases attack speed and damage of Mirana and all allied heroes, reaching maximum power after %max_damage_time%s.

Allies receive %ally_pct%%% of the bonus.

逐渐提升米拉娜和所有友方英雄的攻击速度和攻击力，%max_damage_time%秒后达到最大威力。

友军获得%ally_pct%%%加成效果。

monkey_king_boundless_strike.excerpt: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.

Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.
齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

monkey_king_jingu_mastery.excerpt: Jingu Mastery
Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
如意棒法
齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下%charges%次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

monkey_king_tree_dance.excerpt: Tree Dance

Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.
Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
丛林之舞
齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
提升丛林之舞的最高等级。%max_level%级丛林之舞会把冷却时间降低至0。
丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

monkey_king_wukongs_command.excerpt: Wukong's Command
Also grants Mischief

Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.

Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
猴子猴孙
另外提供七十二变

齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的%attack_speed%秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。

齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
齐天大圣的猴子猴孙持续时间更长，而且离开圆阵后不会马上消散，除非他在圆阵外停留的时间超过%leadership_time_buffer%秒。
在猴子猴孙期间获得技能“出神入化”。
每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。
猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。

morphling_accumulation.excerpt: Morphling receives %percent_to_increment%%% of stat growth bonuses every half level instead of the full bonus at level up. All Attributes bonuses from skill points in the Talent Tree provide an additional +%bonus_primary_stat_per_level_of_attributes% to Morphling's primary attribute.
变体精灵每半级获得%percent_to_increment%%%属性成长加成，而不是升级时获得全额加成。天赋树的全属性附加技能点额外对变体精灵提供+%bonus_primary_stat_per_level_of_attributes% 主属性。

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.excerpt: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.\n\nKnockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.

用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。\n\n击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。

morphling_ebb_and_flow.excerpt: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.
变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

morphling_morph_agi.excerpt: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
属性变换（敏捷获取）
变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。
属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。

morphling_morph_str.excerpt: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
属性变换（力量获取）
变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。
属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。

morphling_replicate.excerpt: Morph
Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.

Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
变形
使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标<font color=\"#FF0000\">改变</font>自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
变形增加<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。
变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。

mud_golem_rock_destroy.excerpt: On death, Mud Golems shatter into several Shard Golems.
死亡时泥土傀儡会破碎成数个碎土傀儡。

muerta_dead_shot.excerpt: Dead Shot

Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
弹无虚发

琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。

跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
弹无虚发恐惧敌人后，神枪在手的触发几率提升至基础几率的%gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%倍，持续%gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%秒。
弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。
被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的%ricochet_distance_multiplier%倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。

muerta_the_calling.excerpt: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.
召唤%num_revenants%个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
唤魂内有敌方英雄阵亡会刷新持续时间，再产生一个亡魂，并且唤魂的作用范围扩大%kill_radius_expansion%。

naga_siren_ensnare.excerpt: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。

necrolyte_death_seeker.excerpt: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。

necronomicon_archer_aoe.excerpt: 提升周围单位的移动速度。

necronomicon_archer_purge.excerpt: Dispels positive buffs from enemies and slows their movement speed.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
The slow starts at 100%% and decreases over time to 20%%.
驱散敌人身上的有益状态，并且减缓其移动速度。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
减速效果起始时为100%%，然后持续减少至20%%。

nevermore_frenzy.excerpt: Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.\n\n Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。\n\n从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。

nevermore_necromastery.excerpt: Necromastery

Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
Increases max souls.
Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
支配死灵
影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
每次击杀英雄会使灵魂上限增加%max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill%个，直到影魔阵亡。
提高灵魂数量上限。
反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

nevermore_requiem.excerpt: Requiem of Souls

Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
Must draft Necromastery to do damage.
One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
魂之挽歌

影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。
必须拥有支配死灵才能造成伤害。
影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

night_stalker_crippling_fear.excerpt: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。

night_stalker_heart_of_darkness.excerpt: Night Stalker's health regeneration is increased during the night and decreased during the day.
Heart of Darkness now also applies to mana regeneration at night with the same values as health regeneration. Increases the duration of night time by %nighttime_increase%s.
暗夜魔王的生命恢复在夜间提升，白天降低。
Heart of Darkness now also applies to mana regeneration at night with the same values as health regeneration. Increases the duration of night time by %nighttime_increase%s.

night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.excerpt: Hunter in the Night
Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.
暗夜猎影
暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。
可以主动对一个普通单位施放暗夜猎影，将其秒杀并恢复暗夜魔王最大生命和魔法的一定百分比。在白天无法对远古生物施放。
暗夜猎影的最高等级提升至%max_level_tooltip%级。暗夜魔王初始就额外拥有一级暗夜猎影。

night_stalker_night_reign.excerpt: The game now starts at night instead of day. Night is longer than day.
比赛现在会从夜晚开始，而不是白天。夜晚时间比白天长。

night_stalker_void.excerpt: Void
Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.
Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
虚空
制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。
虚空作用下的敌人不会与友军共享视野。当不在友军视野中，他们会受到每秒伤害。
提升虚空的最高等级。%max_level%级虚空在夜间变为以范围为目标的技能，移动速度和攻击速度降低效果提升，并且施加%cast_radius_tooltip%范围效果。
虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。

nyx_assassin_jolt.excerpt: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
Mind Flare burns mana equal to a percentage of the target's max mana.
造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
神智爆裂会燃烧相当于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。

nyx_assassin_vendetta.excerpt: Vendetta
Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
复仇
冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。在复仇的最初%free_pathing_duration%秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。

司夜刺客进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。

obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment.excerpt: Astral Imprisonment
Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.

Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
星体禁锢
窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。
星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。
被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。

obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium.excerpt: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
When Essence Flux restores mana, it also temporarily increases maximum mana.
被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。
精华变迁回复魔法时，还会暂时增加最大魔法值。

obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse.excerpt: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.
释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。
受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。

ogre_magi_dumb_luck.excerpt: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.
食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。

ogre_magi_fireblast.excerpt: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.
Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.
以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。

ogre_magi_ignite.excerpt: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a %ignite_multicast_aoe% area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.
使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。

omniknight_guardian_angel.excerpt: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.
全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

omniknight_hammer_of_purity.excerpt:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.

全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。

全能骑士会在%heal_duration%秒内回复%heal_pct%%%造成的伤害。

oracle_diviners_deck.excerpt:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every %duration% seconds to receives its buff for %duration% seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: %spell_amplification%%% Spell Amplification
The Fool: %gold_bonus_pct%%% Increased Gold Gain
The World: %int_bonus_pct%%% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: %heal_amplification%%% Heal Amplification
The Tower: %barrier_amount% All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for %barrier_restore_time%s)

神谕者会立刻抽取一张塔罗牌，之后每%duration%秒一次，每张的加成效果持续%duration%秒。神谕者知道接下来是哪张塔罗牌。

死亡：%spell_amplification%%%技能增强
愚者：%gold_bonus_pct%%%金钱获取提升
世界：%int_bonus_pct%%%智力值提升
恋人：%heal_amplification%%%治疗增强
高塔：%barrier_amount%点全伤害护盾（%barrier_restore_time%秒后未受到伤害会恢复）

oracle_fortunes_end.excerpt: CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

oracle_purifying_flames.excerpt: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.
将目标身上一切不洁之物净化，对其造成大量魔法伤害，并使其在接下来的一段时间内逐渐恢复生命值。恢复的生命值总量将超过受到的伤害。可对友方和敌方单位施放。
涤罪之焰的治疗效果可以相互叠加。
涤罪之焰的伤害对友军不会致死。

pangolier_gyroshell.excerpt: Rolling Thunder

Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Rolling Thunder movement and turn speed increased, but duration is decreased.
Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
地雷滚滚

石鳞剑士卷成一个<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
地雷滚滚的移动和转身速度提升，但是持续时间减少。
敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

pangolier_rollup.excerpt: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

pangolier_shield_crash.excerpt: Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.\n\nForward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
Pangolier can cast Shield Crash a second time mid-flight, dealing more damage and gaining more barrier. Longer flight time results in more damage and barrier increases.
Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。\n\n地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
石鳞剑士可以在半空中再次施放甲盾冲击，造成更高的伤害，并获得更高数值的护盾。在空中的时间越久，伤害和护盾的数值越高。
甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。

pangolier_swashbuckle.excerpt: Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.\n\nLucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。\n\n刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

phantom_assassin_blur.excerpt: Blur
Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
With Scepter, only non-ultimate spells will refresh.
Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
魅影无形
幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。
拥有神杖时只会刷新大招以外的技能。
通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。

phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives.excerpt: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.excerpt: Stifling Dagger

Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
窒碍短匕
对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

phantom_lancer_doppelwalk.excerpt: Doppelganger

Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.
This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
神行百变

幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。
这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。

phantom_lancer_juxtapose.excerpt: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.

Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。
并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

phantom_lancer_spirit_lance.excerpt: Spirit Lance
Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.
Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
灵魂之矛
对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。
灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。
幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。

phoenix_fire_spirits.excerpt: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
召唤4只围绕凤凰飞行的烈火精灵。每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
烈火精灵变成被动充能技能。具有7秒充能时间。
烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。

phoenix_icarus_dive.excerpt: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
Icarus Dive has a %dive_duration% second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.
凤凰向目标方向进行圆弧状飞行，飞行距离固定，对沿途的敌人造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度，然后返回初始位置。飞行过程中如果施放超新星将停止飞行。
凤凰冲击的飞行时间为%dive_duration%秒，可以在飞行途中再次施放来终止飞行。

phoenix_launch_fire_spirit.excerpt: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。

phoenix_sun_ray.excerpt: Sun Ray

Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
In Ability Draft, Sun Ray movement is disabled.  The hero can only turn in place while Sun Ray is active.
Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
烈日炙烤
凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。
在技能征召中，烈日炙烤的移动已被禁用。英雄只能在烈日炙烤生效期间转向。
烈日炙烤的宽度为%radius%，长度为%abilitycastrange%。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。

plus_guild_banner.excerpt: Plant your guild's banner to mark this battleground for you all!
插下你的公会旗帜，为大家标记这片战场！

plus_high_five.excerpt: Throw your hand (or handy appendage) in the air!
高举你的手（或手状附肢）。

primal_beast_colossal.excerpt: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

獸拥有%base_slow_resist%%%基础<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，每拥有%hp_per_threshold%点生命上限就获得+%aoe_per_threshold%%%<font color='#c450e5'>作用范围</font>加成和+%slow_resistance_per_threshold%%%<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。

primal_beast_onslaught.excerpt: Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. \n\n Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。\n\n可以随时使用停止指令来中止。

primal_beast_pulverize.excerpt: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。

primal_beast_rock_throw.excerpt:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

primal_beast_trample.excerpt: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.
獸践踏一切。每行进%step_distance%距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>。
踏启动后会使獸和他的友军获得移动速度加成。

primal_beast_uproar.excerpt: Uproar

The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  \n\n When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
咤
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。\n\n主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

puck_dream_coil.excerpt: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和<font color='#e3d59e'>束缚</font>。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和额外伤害。
梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时攻击也会继续。

puck_illusory_orb.excerpt: Illusory Orb

Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.\n\n At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
For Ability Draft only, Illusory Orb ability swaps with Ethereal Jaunt while the orb is in flight.
The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
幻象法球

以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。\n\n在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
仅在技能征召中，幻象法球在飞行时技能栏中会被替换为灵动之翼。
幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

puck_phase_shift.excerpt: Phase Shift
CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
相位转移
持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。
帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。

puck_waning_rift.excerpt: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.
帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。

pudge_dismember.excerpt: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.
If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
肢解每次对英雄造成伤害时都会提升自身力量值。
即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

pudge_meat_hook.excerpt: Meat Hook

Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.

When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.
Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
肉钩
向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。

肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。

肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。
肉钩会根据牵引的距离造成额外伤害，但基础伤害减少。
钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

pudge_rot.excerpt: Rot
A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
腐烂
能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。
使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。

pugna_decrepify.excerpt: Decrepify
A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
衰老
一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

pugna_life_drain.excerpt: CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.\n\nWhen cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.

Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.

Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。\n\n向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

pugna_nether_ward.excerpt: Nether Ward
Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
Nether Ward restores mana and health to Pugna based on how much damage is dealt.
Increases cast range to %AbilityCastRange%.
Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
幽冥守卫
帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
幽冥守卫会根据造成的伤害使帕格纳回复魔法和生命。
施法距离提升至%AbilityCastRange%。
技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。

queenofpain_shadow_strike.excerpt: Shadow Strike

Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
暗影突袭
投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续%duration%秒。每%damage_interval%秒会再造成一次伤害。
暗影突袭变为%aoe_radius%范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。
受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。

queenofpain_sonic_wave.excerpt: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.
痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

queenofpain_succubus.excerpt: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.
所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到%close_radius%距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过%max_radius%距离时为最弱效果。
技能吸血也对反弹的纯粹和魔法伤害有效。

rattletrap_armor_power.excerpt: Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.\n\nClockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加%damage_per_armor%%%。\n\n发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

rattletrap_battery_assault.excerpt: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

rattletrap_hookshot.excerpt: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
如果发射钩爪击中的目标附近%radius_ally%范围内还有另一名友方英雄，那么发条技师和范围内所有友军都会获得护甲加成，并且部分退还冷却时间和魔法消耗。
发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。

rattletrap_jetpack.excerpt: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。

rattletrap_overclocking.excerpt:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：

弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。
能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。
照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。
发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。
喷气背包：移动得更快。

持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。

rattletrap_power_cogs.excerpt:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.

Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.

在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。

敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

rattletrap_rocket_flare.excerpt: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.
向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。

razor_plasma_field.excerpt: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。

razor_static_link.excerpt: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.
The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。
链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。

razor_storm_surge.excerpt: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

riki_backstab.excerpt: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
力丸遁入阴影，变为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。

riki_smoke_screen.excerpt: Smoke Screen
Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.
烟幕
丢下一个烟雾弹，<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

riki_tricks_of_the_trade.excerpt: Tricks of the Trade
CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.

Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.

Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
绝杀秘技
持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
击中所有单位都会施加背刺伤害。
绝杀秘技攻击非英雄单位时拥有%creep_agility_multiplier%倍敏捷加成。只要力丸在绝杀秘技期间击杀一个非英雄单位，冷却时间就会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%秒。
提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。

ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs.excerpt:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.

只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。

如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
百戏大王的纪念品是哈哈镜，强力水和整蛊垫。
百戏大王的纪念品是水晶球，独轮车和超重派。

ringmaster_funhouse_mirror.excerpt:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

使用：比例失真

制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

ringmaster_impalement.excerpt: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。

ringmaster_spotlight.excerpt: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。

ringmaster_strongman_tonic.excerpt:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

使用：强力吸收

暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。

ringmaster_summon_unicycle.excerpt:
Use: Saddle Up

Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

使用：上车

召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

ringmaster_tame_the_beasts.excerpt: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。

ringmaster_the_box.excerpt: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态，获得额外魔法抗性、<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被<font color='#c3e1db'>锁闭</font>、<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>和<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

ringmaster_wheel.excerpt:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。

敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。

ringmaster_whoopee_cushion.excerpt:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

使用：噗

把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。

roshan_grab_and_throw.excerpt: Heroes that get in Roshan's way while he's moving between pits will be violently thrown away. Upon landing, heroes take damage and become stunned for %stun_duration% second. Deals additional damage for each throw he's done within one cycle of moving between pits.
Heroes will be thrown away from Roshan based on their relative position to Roshan.
肉山在巢穴之间移动时，会把挡路的英雄抓起再猛地扔出去。英雄落地后会受到伤害，并被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%stun_duration%秒。巢穴之间移动的每个周期内，每次肉山扔出英雄后扔出伤害都会增加。
英雄被肉山扔出的方向取决于他们和他之间的相对位置。

roshan_revengeroar.excerpt: When facing the team that last killed him, Roshan will release an angry roar, heard everywhere on the map, that damages everyone in a %radius% AoE and disarms them for %disarm_duration% seconds. Units that have been roared take %damage_pct%%% increased incoming damage.
肉山在面对上次击杀他的队伍时，会发出一声愤怒的咆哮，全地图都可以听到，对%radius%范围内所有单位造成伤害，并且<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>%disarm_duration%秒。被咆哮作用的单位受到的伤害将提高%disarm_duration%%%。

rubick_curiosity.excerpt:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%作用范围加成。

如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。

rubick_fade_bolt.excerpt: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。

rubick_spell_steal.excerpt: Spell Steal
Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
Stolen spells also have lower mana cost.
Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
技能窃取
拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
窃取技能的魔法消耗也会降低。
可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。
窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。
无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。

rubick_telekinesis.excerpt: Telekinesis
Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.
While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
隔空取物
拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至%max_land_distance%，投掷延迟降低至%shard_teammate_throw_delay%秒。
目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。

sandking_burrowstrike.excerpt:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

Burrowstrike becomes a vector-targeted ability, allowing Sand King to create a secondary burrowstrike past his initial target location. The secondary burrowstrike distance and damage can be up to %underground_distance_pct%%% of a normal burrowstrike.

沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
掘地穿刺变成以矢量为目标的技能，使沙王可以在经过初始目标地点时产生第二个掘地穿刺。第二个掘地穿刺的距离和伤害最高为普通掘地穿刺的%underground_distance_pct%%%。

sandking_epicenter.excerpt: Epicenter

After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
地震
经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。
地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

sandking_sand_storm.excerpt: Sand Storm
Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
沙尘暴
沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

sandking_scorpion_strike.excerpt: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.
沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

satyr_trickster_purge.excerpt: The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
萨特放逐者通晓所有的诡计，让他能驱散友军身上的负面效果或者敌人身上的增益效果。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

seasonal_dark_carnival_firework.excerpt: Shoot a firework into the air.

seasonal_party_hat.excerpt: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.
Spirit of Frostivus becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Hats are taken from enemies first, then evenly distributed amongst allies.
持续施法。偷取一顶敌方英雄的迎霜节帽子，或者把自己的一顶帽子送给一名友方英雄。
迎霜精神变为范围型技能，影响目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内的单位。会先拿走敌人的帽子，然后均分给友军。

seasonal_summon_penguin.excerpt: Summon a friendly penguin who slides around. Each time a hero bumps the penguin, it gains speed and lasts a bit longer.
Your team's penguins will pass through enemy heroes that you don't have vision of.
召唤一只友好的企鹅在周围滑行。每次企鹅被英雄碰到后都会加速，持续时间也会延长。
己方企鹅碰到视野外的敌方英雄时会直接穿过去。

shadow_demon_demonic_purge.excerpt: Demonic Purge

Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
邪恶净化
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
邪恶净化具有<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。
减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

shadow_demon_disruption.excerpt: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。

shadow_shaman_fowl_play.excerpt: Fowl Play

When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
禽戏
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。
无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.excerpt: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
