earthshaker_enchant_totem.excerpt: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。
强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。

earthshaker_fissure.excerpt: Fissure
Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.
Requires drafting Aftershock for Shard upgrade to work.
沟壑
用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>的时间有所降低。
被沟壑击中的敌方英雄会对%echoes_radius%范围内附近每个单位释放一道回音，造成的伤害等同于回音击的%echoes_damage_multiplier%%%当前回音伤害。
必须拥有余震才会具有魔晶升级效果。

earthshaker_slugger.excerpt: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.
利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。

elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.excerpt: Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.\n\nThe Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。\n\n灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

elder_titan_earth_splitter.excerpt: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
上古巨神向前方放出一道不平坦的裂纹。3秒后裂纹塌陷，范围内的单位将被减速，并受到基于他们自身生命最大值的伤害。其中一半伤害为魔法伤害，另一半为物理伤害。

elder_titan_echo_stomp.excerpt: Echo Stomp

CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
Echo Stomp will still apply both the physical and magical damage values regardless of Astral Spirit being drafted.
If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
回音重踏
持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。
不论是否拥有技能“灵体游魂”，回音重踏都会同时造成物理和魔法伤害。
若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。

elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit.excerpt: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.  Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.
上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。昏迷的敌人受到伤害会被惊醒。

elder_titan_momentum.excerpt: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.
上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant.excerpt: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。

ember_spirit_fire_remnant.excerpt: Fire Remnant

Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
残焰
可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的%speed_multiplier%%%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。
提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。
学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。

ember_spirit_flame_guard.excerpt: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional %linger_duration% seconds after application.
灰烬之灵用火焰之环将自己包裹起来，会消耗受到的魔法伤害，使受到的魔法伤害被吸收一定百分比。烈火罩开启后会对灰烬之灵周围的敌人造成每秒伤害。<font color='#1278b9'>护盾</font>消失后将失去伤害效果。
魔法伤害的吸收伤害值计算先于任何伤害减免效果。
伤害在施加后会额外粘滞%linger_duration%秒。

ember_spirit_searing_chains.excerpt: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.
灰烬之灵释放出火焰绳索来<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>附近的敌人，将他们困于原地并每秒造成一定伤害。
将随机选取炘周围的单位作为目标。
不能作用于减益免疫或隐身单位。

ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.excerpt: Sleight of Fist
Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.

When Sleight of Fist connects with %min_enemies_for_double_sleight% or more enemies, the enemy closest to Ember Spirit will be attacked a second time. Damage for the second attack is reduced by %second_attack_damage_penalty%%%.
Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
无影拳
灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
无影拳击中的敌人超过%min_enemies_for_double_sleight%个时，距离灰烬之灵最近的敌人会再次受到攻击。第二次攻击的伤害减少%second_attack_damage_penalty%%%。
在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为%attack_interval%秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。

enchantress_enchant.excerpt: Enchant

Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Cast Range of Enchant is increased. If the enemy is a hero, Enchantress and units she controls have increased attack range against the target.
Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
Illusions can be converted.
魅惑

魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
魅惑的施法距离增加。如果目标是英雄，魅惑魔女和她控制的单位对目标的攻击距离增加。
魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。
可以转化幻象。

enchantress_impetus.excerpt: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.
激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
造成伤害上限的距离是%distance_cap%。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。

enchantress_little_friends.excerpt: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.
魅惑魔女<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续%duration%秒。

enchantress_natures_attendants.excerpt: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.

Whenever Enchantress takes more than %overprotective_damage_threshold% damage from enemy heroes, %overprotective_wisp_count% wisp appears for %overprotective_wisp_duration%s to heal her. A maximum of %overprotective_max_wisps% overprotective wisps can exist at the same time.
Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
只要魅惑魔女受到敌方英雄的伤害超过%overprotective_damage_threshold%点，%overprotective_wisp_count%个小精灵就会出现，%overprotective_wisp_duration%秒内进行治疗。同一时间最多只能存在%overprotective_max_wisps%个过度保护的小精灵。
不会选择满血单位进行治疗。

enigma_black_hole.excerpt: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.
持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

enigma_demonic_conversion.excerpt: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。

enigma_malefice.excerpt: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。每%tick_rate%秒<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>一次。
憎恶的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

enigma_splitting_image.excerpt: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.

Whenever Enigma takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source, he spawns an Eidolon next to him. Damage counter resets to zero after %damage_reset_interval%s. Eidolons created in this fashion grant %non_splitting_bounty_reduction_tooltip%%% experience and gold.
谜团受到伤害时会产生虚灵体。
每当谜团受到任意来源的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点，他的身旁都会产生一个虚灵体。伤害累计会在%damage_reset_interval%秒后清零。这种方式产生的虚灵体提供的击杀经验和金钱减少%non_splitting_bounty_reduction_tooltip%%%。

enraged_wildkin_tornado.excerpt: CHANNELED - The Wildwing calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a sentient Tornado that he can control. The Tornado slows nearby enemies and does damage. It is invulnerable and can move anywhere.
持续施法 - 枭兽召唤风之灵，创造一股有知觉的飓风供他驱使。飓风对附近的敌人造成减速和伤害。飓风是无敌的，可以随意移动。

faceless_void_time_dilation.excerpt: Time Dilation

Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
时间膨胀
虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。
不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。

faceless_void_time_lock.excerpt: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
Does not stack with Skull Basher.
In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.
攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>锁定</font>在时间中，再次发动攻击。
技能征召中，与碎颅锤叠加。

faceless_void_time_walk.excerpt: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。
虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。

faceless_void_time_zone.excerpt: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.
在时空中创造一个遮罩，改变其中所有单位的移动、攻击、施法、弹道和转身速度。友军的速度提升，冷却加快。敌人的速度降低，技能和物品的冷却全部冻结。不会影响终极技能。时间膨胀的负面状态持续时间在逆转时空内不会变少。

flagbearer_creep_aura_effect.excerpt: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.
Magic resistance bonus upgrades by %bonus_magic_resistance_per_interval%%% every 7.5 minutes, up to a maximum of %maximum_intervals% upgrades.
旗手鼓舞所有友方小兵，提供额外生命恢复和魔法抗性。
魔法抗性加成每7.5分钟升级一次，增加%bonus_magic_resistance_per_interval%%%，最高为%maximum_intervals%次升级。

forest_troll_high_priest_mana_aura.excerpt: Provides bonus mana regeneration to all nearby allies.
为周围所有友军提供额外的魔法恢复。

frogmen_congregation_of_the_deep.excerpt: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.
向所有方向放出一片触手，对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。

frogmen_tendrils_of_the_deep.excerpt: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.
向目标方向放出一片锥形的触手，对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。

furion_force_of_nature.excerpt: Nature's Call
Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
Whenever Nature's Prophet takes damage, treants in a %radius% AoE heal him for %damage_transfer_pct%%%  of the damage taken at the cost of their own health
Summons a reduced number of stronger Treants with reinforced damage.
Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
自然的呼唤
将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
每当自然先知受到伤害，%radius%范围内的树人会以自身生命值为代价治疗%damage_transfer_pct%%%所受伤害
召唤的树人数量减少，但是威力变大，而且拥有坚锐技能。
自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。

furion_natures_profit.excerpt: Whenever Nature's Prophet kills an enemy hero or one dies within a %radius% radius, a money tree is created in their place. Every tick, several bags of gold are dropped that can be picked up by nearby heroes. The amount of gold is equal to a multiplier of the slain hero level.
只要有敌方英雄被自然先知击杀，或者在他附近%radius%范围内阵亡，会在原地长出一棵摇钱树。每次都会掉落若干金袋，所有英雄都可以拾取。每个金袋提供的金钱等于阵亡英雄等级的数倍。

furion_sprout.excerpt: Sprout
Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
After Sprout is cast, all trees in a %healing_radius% radius emit an aura that heals nearby allies. Allied Tangos provide double the heal duration when consuming a tree created by Sprout.
Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
发芽
使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供%vision_range%范围内的视野。
施放发芽后附近%healing_radius%范围内的树木会散发出治疗附近友军的光环。友军的树之祭祀吞食发芽产生的树木会提供双倍治疗时间。
发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。

furion_wrath_of_nature.excerpt: Wrath of Nature

Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.
Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
自然之怒
伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中%max_targets%个目标后达到最高伤害。
<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从%scepter_min_entangle_duration%秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为%scepter_max_entangle_duration%秒。
自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。

grimstroke_dark_artistry.excerpt:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.

天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
绝笔额外从另一只手发出对称的墨迹曲线。每个敌人只能受到一道墨迹的伤害，但是同时计入两道墨迹的额外伤害。

grimstroke_dark_portrait.excerpt: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

grimstroke_ink_creature.excerpt: Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.\n\nHero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。\n\n英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

grimstroke_soul_chain.excerpt: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.
将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。

grimstroke_spirit_walk.excerpt: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.

Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
墨涌可以手动提前引爆。

墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散

gyrocopter_call_down.excerpt: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
The visual indicator is visible to allies only.
召唤%total_strikes%波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔%strike_separation%距离。
视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。

gyrocopter_homing_missile.excerpt: Homing Missile

Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.

Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
追踪导弹
发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。
防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。

gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.excerpt: Rocket Barrage
Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
Every successful hit of a Rocket Barrage rocket on an enemy hero increases Gyrocopter's movement speed.
Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.
火箭弹幕
向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续%barrage_duration%秒。
火箭弹幕每次成功击中敌方英雄都会提升矮人直升机的移动速度。
火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。

gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability.excerpt: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.
矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每%sidegunner_fire_rate%秒对矮人直升机附近%AbilityCastRange%范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

hoodwink_acorn_shot.excerpt: Acorn Shot

Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.\nIf point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
If there are no bounce targets within range of Acorn Shot, it can bounce off a nearby tree and set the remaining number of bounces to %bounces_after_tree_bounce%.
The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
爆栗出击
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。\n可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
如果附近没有可弹射的目标，爆栗出击会弹射至附近的树木，剩余弹射次数将设为%bounces_after_tree_bounce%次。
同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。

hoodwink_bushwhack.excerpt: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.
扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

hoodwink_decoy.excerpt: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
Does not requires Bushwhack to be drafted for full effect.
森海飞霞变为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
不需要选择野地奇袭也能获得全额效果。

hoodwink_hunters_boomerang.excerpt: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

hoodwink_scurry.excerpt: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.
森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。
密林奔走还会提供攻击和施法距离加成。

hoodwink_sharpshooter.excerpt: Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.\nHoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

Sharpshooter has a %quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%% reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, and wind-up times are reduced by %quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%. Turn rate is increased by %turn_rate_tooltip%%%.
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。\n由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
提升箭矢速度和减速效果。
一箭穿心的冷却时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%%。伤害、负面状态持续时间和装载时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%。转身速率提升%turn_rate_tooltip%%%。

hoodwink_tomokan_tracker.excerpt: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last %trail_history_duration% seconds in a %search_radius% area around her.
Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last %trail_history_duration% seconds in a %search_radius% area around her.

huskar_berserkers_blood.excerpt: Berserker's Blood
Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.

Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
狂战士之血
哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
狂战士之血可以消耗一定生命来主动开启。驱散哈斯卡，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。

huskar_inner_fire.excerpt: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。

huskar_life_break.excerpt: Life Break

Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.
Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
牺牲
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
牺牲还会使目标附近的敌人减速。
牺牲还会治疗目标附近的友方单位。
强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。
如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

invoker_chaos_meteor.excerpt: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。
每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为%damage_interval%秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续%burn_duration%秒。

invoker_deafening_blast.excerpt: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。

invoker_emp.excerpt: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，%delay%秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得%self_mana_restore_pct%%%损毁的魔法。
提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。
对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。

invoker_forge_spirit.excerpt: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>和<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>中等级较低的元素。
施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

invoker_forge_spirit_ad.excerpt: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.
祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。元素精灵的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。
施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

invoker_ghost_walk.excerpt: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>等级成反比。
减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。
现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

invoker_ghost_walk_ad.excerpt: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
The slow effect does not work on Debuff Immune enemies.
祈求者操纵冰雷之力围绕自身，使自己隐形。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果基于技能等级。
减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

invoker_ice_wall.excerpt: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.

Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，每秒伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。
寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道%wall_width%宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过%root_delay%秒的敌方英雄会基于<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的等级被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>并受到魔法伤害。

invoker_ice_wall_ad.excerpt: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.
The slow will still affect Debuff Immune enemies if their debuff immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.
在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成大幅减速和每秒伤害，
如果敌人在受到寒冰之墙作用后获得减益免疫状态，那么减速效果对其依然有效。

invoker_sun_strike.excerpt: Sun Strike

Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
阳炎冲击
向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。
阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。
施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。

invoker_sun_strike_ad.excerpt: Sun Strike (AD)
Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

Adds Cataclysm. Launched when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
阳炎冲击（OMG）
向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。区域内所有敌人将平摊伤害。
施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。
增加毁天灭地。双击阳炎冲击进行施放。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击。

invoker_tornado.excerpt: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, dealing damage based on <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>等级。滞空时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>等级。落地伤害取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。
强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

invoker_tornado_ad.excerpt: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助的漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。行进距离取决于技能等级，敌人将滞空一定时间。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。

jakiro_double_trouble.excerpt: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
The second attack ignores Damage Block.
Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.
杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。
杰奇洛的双重攻击造成更高伤害。

jakiro_dual_breath.excerpt: Dual Breath
An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
冰火交加
杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有%fire_delay%秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

jakiro_ice_path.excerpt: Ice Path
Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.
It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
冰封路径
在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
杰奇洛可以选择随时摧毁冰封路径，再次对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
冰封路径的持续时间变长，并且结束时会引爆，再次对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。冰封路径可以手动提前引爆。
路径完全成形需要%path_delay%秒。
冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。

jakiro_liquid_fire.excerpt: Liquid Fire
Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
Works on both units and buildings.
Shard does NOT grant Liquid Frost ability.
液态火
杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。
对单位和建筑都有效。
魔晶不会提供液态冰技能。

jakiro_liquid_ice.excerpt: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

jakiro_macropyre.excerpt: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.

Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.
杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速%ice_edge_movement_slow%%%。
被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到%linger_duration%秒伤害效果。

juggernaut_blade_dance.excerpt: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。

juggernaut_blade_fury.excerpt: Blade Fury

Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.
You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
剑刃风暴
舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%，并且每%blade_fury_damage_tick%秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。

提升作用范围并减速范围内的敌人。

主宰每%attack_interval%秒对作用的敌人发动一次攻击。
剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。

juggernaut_duelist.excerpt: Juggernaut deals %front_damage_increase%%% more damage to targets that are facing him. Damage bonus always applies during Omnislash.
主宰对面朝他的目标造成的伤害增加%front_damage_increase%%%。额外伤害在无敌斩期间始终有效。

juggernaut_healing_ward.excerpt: Healing Ward

Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
Increases ward healing and health.
The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
治疗守卫
召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为%healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip%。持续%abilityduration%秒。
提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。
可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。

keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.excerpt: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.
恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。

keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.excerpt: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.
持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

keeper_of_the_light_recall.excerpt: Recall

After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.

Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.
If Keeper of the Light dies, the spell effect is interrupted.
Recall will interrupt channeling spells.
You can disable help to prevent Keeper from casting this spell on you.
Can be cast through the minimap, choosing the nearest friendly hero.
召回

短暂延迟后，将友方英雄目标传送到你的位置。如果在此期间，友方英雄目标受到来自玩家的伤害，召回将被打断。施放时会对光之守卫和传送目标同时施加移动速度加成，并且传送目标会被施加查克拉魔法。

如果设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），会把光之守卫传送至目标友军。

技能等级随着灵魂形态的等级提升。
如果光之守卫死亡，技能效果将会中断。
召回将打断持续施法。
可以选择禁用帮助，防止光之守卫对你使用此技能。
可以点击小地图施放，将会选择施放点最近的友方英雄。

keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp.excerpt: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.
在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

kez_echo_slash.excerpt: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

kez_falcon_rush.excerpt: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。

kez_grappling_claw.excerpt: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。

kez_raptor_dance.excerpt:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

kez_ravens_veil.excerpt: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到他攻击或施法。
提升渡鸦之纱的隐身时间。

kez_shodo_sai.excerpt:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

kez_talon_toss.excerpt: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
The fixed damage attack has True Strike.
凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

kunkka_ghostship.excerpt: Ghostship

Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.

Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
幽灵船

召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。

被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。
幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。

kunkka_tidebringer.excerpt: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。

kunkka_torrent.excerpt: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和减速。
初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.excerpt: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.

Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。
对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。

largo_amphibian_rhapsody.excerpt: Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.\n\nEvery time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
Items can be used while in this mode.
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。\n\n每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。
这个模式下可以使用物品。

largo_croak_of_genius.excerpt: Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.\n\nWhen an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。\n\n只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。

largo_encore.excerpt: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
Does not work on buffs with forced movement or relocation out of world.
朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。

只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。

只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。
对强制位移或离开地图的增益效果不会生效。

largo_frogstomp.excerpt: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。

largo_song_double_time.excerpt: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
Increases nearby friendly units' movement speed by %movespeed_bonus_burst%%% and grants a brief %slow_resistance%%% slow resistance.
朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。
提升附近友方单位%movespeed_bonus_burst%%%移动速度，还有短时间的%slow_resistance%%%<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。

largo_song_fight_song.excerpt: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

Deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. Increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification by %spell_amp_bonus%%% and grants their attacks additional %magic_damage_bonus%%% magic damage.
朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。
对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。提升附近友方英雄的%spell_amp_bonus%%%技能增强，并且他们的攻击造成额外%magic_damage_bonus%%%魔法伤害。

largo_song_good_vibrations.excerpt: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
Grants %heal_burst% healing to nearby friendly heroes.
朗戈弹奏的乐曲会<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近友方英雄。
治疗附近友方英雄%heal_burst%点生命。

legion_commander_duel.excerpt: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
军团指挥官强制与目标敌方英雄进行决斗，持续短暂的数秒。决斗开始后双方英雄不能使用任何物品，而目标敌方英雄不能使用技能。如果有英雄在决斗期间死亡，赢得决斗的英雄将永久获得攻击力加成。
如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。
如果双方距离超过2000，决斗也会结束。

legion_commander_moment_of_courage.excerpt: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.
每当受到攻击达到一定次数，军团指挥官都会对目标立即作出反击，而且此次攻击具有吸血效果。
只有在攻击他人时受到攻击才会触发带有吸血的反击。

legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.excerpt: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.
用敌人的数量反制他们，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害，击中时施加%movement_slow%%%减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。范围内每个敌方单位和英雄都会使伤害提升。另外还会向军团指挥官提供攻击速度加成。
压倒性优势的范围更大，会根据对敌方英雄造成的伤害提供<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。

legion_commander_press_the_attack.excerpt: Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Increases movement speed and becomes an %radius% area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.
移除友方目标单位的负面效果和控制技能，并提升其移动速度和生命恢复，持续一定时间。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
提升移动速度，变为%radius%范围型技能，而且使用时总是会作用于军团指挥官。

leshrac_diabolic_edict.excerpt: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
Diabolic Edict hits enemies with an increased explosion rate but it no longer damages buildings.
The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
恶魔敕令以更高的爆炸速度击中敌人，但是不再对建筑造成伤害。
即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。

leshrac_lightning_storm.excerpt: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。

leshrac_pulse_nova.excerpt: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。

lich_chain_frost.excerpt: Chain Frost

Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
连环霜冻
释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。
连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

lich_sinister_gaze.excerpt: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

life_stealer_feast.excerpt: Feast
Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
Feast's max HP per hero kill is increased.
Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
盛宴
噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
盛宴的击杀英雄获得生命上限已经提升。
对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy.excerpt: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。

life_stealer_infest.excerpt: Infest

Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health. Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.

Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
感染
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。感染可以对远古中立生物使用。
噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。
提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。
吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

life_stealer_open_wounds.excerpt: Open Wounds

Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
Open Wounds' cooldown is refreshed if a unit dies while afflicted by Open Wounds.
Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
撕裂伤口
噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害<font color='#07d738'>回复</font>一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
如果有单位在撕裂伤口效果下阵亡，撕裂伤口的冷却时间将会重置。
撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

life_stealer_rage.excerpt: Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
进入狂暴状态，变成<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

lina_dragon_slave.excerpt: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

lina_fiery_soul.excerpt: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.
莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续%fiery_soul_stack_duration%秒。
每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

lina_flame_cloak.excerpt: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。

lina_laguna_blade.excerpt: Laguna Blade
Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
神灭斩
对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。

lina_slow_burn.excerpt: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.
莉娜的技能会在%burn_duration%秒内额外造成%burn_damage_pct%%%原伤害的烧灼伤害。

lion_impale.excerpt: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并受到伤害。
尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

lion_to_hell_and_back.excerpt:
Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.
击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供%debuff_amp%%%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续%duration%秒的%spell_amp%%%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

lone_druid_entangle.excerpt: Entangle

Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
缠绕之根

敌方英雄获得%hits_required%层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。

施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加%hits_incremented_on_active%层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加%hits_required%层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化%lone_druid_buff_duration%秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加%lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip%层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。

升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加%hits_required%层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。
被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。

lone_druid_gift_bearer.excerpt: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
独行德鲁伊的熊灵会获得他身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

lone_druid_savage_roar.excerpt: Savage Roar
Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.

Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
野蛮咆哮
独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。

施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。

驱散类型：弱驱散
被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。

lone_druid_savage_roar_bear.excerpt: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Lone Druid.
独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。
被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与独行德鲁伊共享冷却时间。

lone_druid_spirit_bear.excerpt: Summon Spirit Bear

Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.\nSpirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.
熊灵伙伴

召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过%bear_attack_leash_range%，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的%backlash_damage%%%作为反冲伤害。\n熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。
提升了独行德鲁伊和熊灵相距较远时允许熊灵攻击的距离。

lone_druid_spirit_bear_demolish.excerpt: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.
熊灵对建筑造成的伤害提升。

lone_druid_spirit_bear_fetch.excerpt: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.
抓住友军/敌方目标，或者是神符，并且不受控制地在持续时间内将其向独行德鲁伊拽去。敌人每%tick_rate%秒受到一次伤害。拖拽过程中目标会被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。

lone_druid_spirit_bear_spirit_link.excerpt: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。

lone_druid_spirit_link.excerpt: Spirit Link
Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
Shared Armor increased. Damage dealt by either the Spirit Bear or Lone Druid will heal the other.
Only damage dealt by Spirit Bear heals Lone Druid.

Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
Break disables the shared lifesteal.
灵魂链接
连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
共享护甲提升。熊灵和独行德鲁伊造成的伤害可以分别治疗对方。
只有熊灵造成的伤害可以治疗独行德鲁伊。

独行德鲁伊切断与熊灵的链接，并与目标友方英雄建立链接，与他们共享灵魂链接的加成效果，持续%duration%秒。护甲共享和攻击速度加成的效果均提升%active_bonus%%%。友军造成的伤害会治疗独行德鲁伊，反之亦然。

熊灵在变形期间会被恐惧，除非熊灵也拥有阿哈利姆神杖。
破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。

lone_druid_true_form.excerpt: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor, more health, and improved versions of Entangling Claws and Demolish.
Lone Druid morphs his Spirit Bear into an enraged form that gains bonus armor, attack speed, demolish damage, and a %entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% cooldown on Entangling Claws.
独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击的能力，但是获得额外护甲，额外生命值和额外攻击力。
独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击能力，但获得了额外护甲和生命值并获得更厉害的缠绕之爪和粉碎击。
独行德鲁伊把自己的熊灵变为狂怒形态，获得额外护甲、攻击速度和粉碎击伤害，并且缠绕之爪的冷却时间减少至%entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

luna_lucent_beam.excerpt: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.
Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
每次一名敌方英雄被月光击中时，露娜都会获得一个攻击力加成的状态效果。月蚀的月光提供%damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%%数值。
召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。

luna_lunar_orbit.excerpt: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.
Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.
产生%rotating_glaives%个月刃在露娜身旁%rotating_glaives_movement_radius%范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
旋转的月刃在开启时提供承受伤害降低的效果。
提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。

lycan_howl.excerpt: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。

lycan_shapeshift.excerpt: Shapeshift

Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control. Enemy heroes killed by Lycan or his units extends Shapeshift duration by %kill_duration_extension%s.
Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.
Ranged heroes will lose attack range during Shapeshift, though bonus range abilities can modify that (i.e. Arctic Burn)
变身
狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
移动速度和致命一击加成效果也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。狼人或他的单位击杀敌方英雄后会使变身的持续时间延长%kill_duration_extension%秒。
狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。
远程英雄在变身期间会相应地失去攻击距离，不过攻击距离加成类技能依然有效（如严寒烧灼）

lycan_summon_wolves.excerpt: Summon Wolves

Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
Summoned Wolves are invulnerable and uncontrollable spirits that do not attack, but provide health and damage bonuses to Lycan.

Max Level increased to %max_level%. Level 5 wolves gain Hamstring, which empowers their attacks to root enemies and cause them to take more physical damage on attacks. Level 6 wolves have Hightail, an active ability that gives wolves phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
召狼
召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
召唤的狼为不可控的无敌幽灵，不会攻击，但会为狼人提供生命和攻击力加成。
最高等级可升至%max_level%级。5级精灵狼获得断筋，使他们的攻击可以缠绕敌人，并且使敌人被攻击时承受更多物理伤害。6级精灵狼拥有健步如飞，主动开启后精灵狼获得相位移动状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度。
召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。
使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。

lycan_summon_wolves_hamstring.excerpt: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next %damage_boost_stacks% attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.
精灵狼咬住敌人的腿筋，短时间内缠绕他们。咬伤之后，狼人控制的单位接下来的%damage_boost_stacks%次攻击会对他们造成额外伤害。

lycan_summon_wolves_hightail.excerpt: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.
精灵狼获得短暂的爆发能量，获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度加成。

magnataur_empower.excerpt: Empower
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. \n\n Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.
授予力量
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。\n\n授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

magnataur_horn_toss.excerpt: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。

magnataur_reverse_polarity.excerpt: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

magnataur_shockwave.excerpt: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level %max_level% Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's current location after reaching max length. The return Shockwave travels %return_shockwave_bonus_distance% distance further and hits enemies a second time for %return_damage_pct_tooltip%%% of the damage.
马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
提升震荡波的最高等级。%max_level%级震荡波会在到达最大长度后会返回至马格纳斯的当前位置。返回的震荡波行进距离增加%return_shockwave_bonus_distance%，对再次击中敌人并造成%return_damage_pct_tooltip%%%伤害。

magnataur_skewer.excerpt: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。
马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

marci_bodyguard.excerpt: Bodyguard

Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.\n\nWhen cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.
Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
护卫术

被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。\n\n对友军施放时，使其获得她的%max_partner_penalty%%%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的%shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%%会补充<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。
在护卫术效果下玛西和她的搭档会共享本技能%shared_healing_percent%%%的生命治疗量。
玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。

marci_companion_run.excerpt: Rebound

Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.\n\n Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.\n\n If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
回身踢

玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。
回身踢设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）时，玛西会把目标友军带向她的最终目的地。友军落地时对敌人造成%ally_impact_damage_pct%%%回身踢伤害。\n\n不会影响被缠绕或束缚的友军。
