When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
地震
经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。
地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

sandking_sand_storm.excerpt: Sand Storm
Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
沙尘暴
沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

sandking_scorpion_strike.excerpt: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.
沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

satyr_trickster_purge.excerpt: The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
萨特放逐者通晓所有的诡计，让他能驱散友军身上的负面效果或者敌人身上的增益效果。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

seasonal_dark_carnival_firework.excerpt: Shoot a firework into the air.

seasonal_party_hat.excerpt: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.
Spirit of Frostivus becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Hats are taken from enemies first, then evenly distributed amongst allies.
持续施法。偷取一顶敌方英雄的迎霜节帽子，或者把自己的一顶帽子送给一名友方英雄。
迎霜精神变为范围型技能，影响目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内的单位。会先拿走敌人的帽子，然后均分给友军。

seasonal_summon_penguin.excerpt: Summon a friendly penguin who slides around. Each time a hero bumps the penguin, it gains speed and lasts a bit longer.
Your team's penguins will pass through enemy heroes that you don't have vision of.
召唤一只友好的企鹅在周围滑行。每次企鹅被英雄碰到后都会加速，持续时间也会延长。
己方企鹅碰到视野外的敌方英雄时会直接穿过去。

shadow_demon_demonic_purge.excerpt: Demonic Purge

Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
邪恶净化
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
邪恶净化具有<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。
减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

shadow_demon_disruption.excerpt: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。

shadow_shaman_fowl_play.excerpt: Fowl Play

When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
禽戏
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。
无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.excerpt: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.
召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。
召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。

shadow_shaman_shackles.excerpt: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

shadow_shaman_voodoo.excerpt: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

shredder_chakram.excerpt: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.
伐木机将主锯刃射向目标区域，锯刃会高速旋转，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被降低。锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。在发射锯刃后伐木机将无法攻击，同时会持续消耗魔法。
如果伐木机魔法不足或移动超过%break_distance%距离，锯齿飞轮将会飞回。

shredder_timber_chain.excerpt: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.

When Timbersaw collides with the target tree, it shatters, sending %tree_splinter_count% splinters in all directions, up to %tree_splinter_distance% distance. If a splinter hits an enemy, they take damage and are slowed for a brief duration.
伐木机发射一条锯链，锯链会嵌入第一棵碰到的树里，然后将他拉向那棵树。行进过程中任何碰到的敌方单位都会受到伤害。
伐木机与目标树木相撞时，树木会破碎，向四面八方放出%tree_splinter_count%片碎木，最远为%tree_splinter_distance%距离。如果碎木击中了敌人，将会造成伤害和短时间的减速。

shredder_twisted_chakram.excerpt: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing.
发射第二个独立的锯齿飞轮，会沿着一道弧线飞出再返回至伐木机，对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被减缓。

shredder_whirling_death.excerpt: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。如果敌方英雄受到了作用，他的主属性将在短时间内降低少许。如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。

silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.excerpt: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

Increases the max level of Glaives of Wisdom. Level %max_level_tooltip% Glaives of Wisdom bounce %bounce_count_tooltip% time to a random target within %bounce_range_tooltip% range. The bounce costs mana upon hit and prioritizes heroes.
Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。
提升智慧之刃的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级智慧之刃会向%bounce_range_tooltip%范围内的一个随机目标弹射%bounce_count_tooltip%次。弹射击中时会消耗魔法，以英雄优先。
使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。

silencer_global_silence.excerpt: Global Silence
Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
The first time Global Silence ends on a unit it is applied again.
This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.
Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
全领域静默
沉默术士停止一切声音，<font color='#6db6e9'>阻止</font>地图上所有敌方英雄和单位施法。
全领域静默在一个单位身上第一次结束后还会再次施加。
沉默效果对隐身和减益免疫单位有效，但是期间获得减益免疫状态将移除该效果。
来自阿哈利姆神杖升级全领域静默的多个奥术诅咒不会叠加。
全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。

skeleton_king_bone_guard.excerpt: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.
击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。

skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.excerpt: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。

skeleton_king_mortal_strike.excerpt: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as <font color=\"#d8ae53\">Pure</font> damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.
冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在%curse_delay%秒延迟后再次受到%curse_damage_pct%%%原攻击伤害的<font color=\"#d8ae53\">纯粹</font>伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

skeleton_king_reincarnation.excerpt: Reincarnation

Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
Reduces cooldown.
When reincarnating, %shard_skeleton_count% skeletons are spawned and attack each nearby enemy hero.
When reincarnating, nearby enemy heroes have their curse cooldowns reset.
Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
绝冥再生
冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
减少冷却时间。
重生过程中会产生%shard_skeleton_count%个骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。
重生过程中附近每个敌方英雄的诅咒冷却时间都会重置。
如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.excerpt: Arcane Bolt
Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.

When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
奥法鹰隼
天怒法师施放出缓慢移动的奥术鹰群，对敌方单位造成基于天怒法师智力值的伤害。
鹰群移动得非常缓慢（500移速），提供325范围的视野。击中目标后，将给予目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
奥法鹰隼无法被躲避。
天怒法师施放奥法鹰隼时，会产生%total_bolt_count%个鹰隼，其中一个飞往原目标，而另外的两个飞往原目标附近%extra_bolt_search_radius%范围内随机敌人。以英雄为首要目标。

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.excerpt: Concussive Shot
Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
震荡光弹
天怒法师释放一个远距离的光弹，将击中超大范围内最近的英雄。击中后会对英雄附近范围内所有单位造成伤害和减速。
如果作用范围内没有英雄或英雄处于迷雾中，震荡光弹将以最近的敌方小兵或中立生物为目标。
击中英雄后附近的非英雄单位也会受到伤害。
光弹将给予400范围的附近视野，击中后将获得目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
天怒法师施放震荡光弹时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

slardar_amplify_damage.excerpt: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.
削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
斯拉达的护甲提升，数值为侵蚀雾霭降低护甲总数的%armor_pct%%%。

slardar_slithereen_crush.excerpt: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
提升鱼人碎击水洼的作用范围和持续时间。
鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

slark_dark_pact.excerpt: Dark Pact

After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
%delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.
黑暗契约
短暂延迟后，斯拉克牺牲部分生命力，清除大部分负面状态并对自己和周围敌方单位造成伤害。斯拉克自身只受到造成伤害的%self_damage_pct%%%。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
经过%delay%秒施法延迟后，每隔%pulse_interval%秒释放1道伤害波造成伤害，总共%total_pulses%道。
每道伤害波还会移除斯拉克身上的负面效果。
不能使用此技能自杀。
如果斯拉克死亡，伤害波将停止释放。

slark_essence_shift.excerpt: Essence Shift

Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.
能量转移
斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

slark_pounce.excerpt: Pounce
Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
Provides charges and increases range.
突袭
斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
突袭在击中敌方英雄时会施加能量转移的叠加次数。
施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。
变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

slark_saltwater_shiv.excerpt:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。

这个效果独立叠加。

slark_shadow_dance.excerpt:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

当斯拉克不处于敌方视野内时，他会被动获得移动速度加成和生命恢复。如果受到来自中立单位的伤害，%neutral_disable%秒内会失去被动移速和生命恢复加成。

主动开启后，斯拉克将自己藏进暗影之云，变成隐身状态，不会被反隐手段发现。攻击、施法、使用物品都不会使斯拉克显形，但是敌人可以看见暗影之云。

snapfire_buckshot.excerpt: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals %damage_amp%%% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a %miss_chance%%% chance of a glancing shot, dealing %glancing_shot_damage_pct%%% damage.
Whenever Snapfire glances or misses an attack, ricochet attacks will bounce towards nearby enemies.
攻击敌方英雄时，电炎绝手的普通攻击造成的伤害增加%damage_amp%%%，但是有%miss_chance%%%几率射偏，只造成%glancing_shot_damage_pct%%%伤害。
Whenever Snapfire glances or misses an attack, ricochet attacks will bounce towards nearby enemies.

snapfire_firesnap_cookie.excerpt: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.
电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
龙炎饼干变得更具威力，<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

snapfire_lil_shredder.excerpt: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
Sets base attack time to %base_attack_time%s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.
电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动%buffed_attacks%次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为%base_attack_time%。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

snapfire_mortimer_kisses.excerpt: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.
电炎绝手的伙伴在%duration_tooltip%秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为%min_range%。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。

snapfire_scatterblast.excerpt: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
Scatterblast is narrower and longer. Bonus damage and slow when enemies are not in point blank range.
电炎绝手开枪产生大范围的爆炸，对锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害和减速。平射距离内的伤害提升%point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%%，移动速度减缓、攻击速度降低和减速持续时间额外提升%point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%%。
电光石火更窄更长。对平射距离外的敌人造成额外伤害和减速。

snapfire_spit_creep.excerpt: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。

sniper_assassinate.excerpt: Assassinate

Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
暗杀
狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间更久。
准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。

sniper_concussive_grenade.excerpt: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>和减速。
降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

sniper_shrapnel.excerpt: Shrapnel

Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
榴霰弹
消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过%abilitychargerestoretime%秒恢复1点。
榴霰弹的减速和伤害提升，但是持续时间减少。
总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
不会对建筑造成伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。

sniper_take_aim.excerpt: Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.\n\nOn cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
被动提升狙击手%passive_attack_range_bonus%攻击距离。\n\n主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速%slow%%%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。

special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5.excerpt: +{s:bonus_ms} Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons
The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.
兽王及其召唤物+{s:bonus_ms} 移速
移动速度光环为全地图生效，死亡后依然有效，作用于兽王和他的所有召唤物。

spectre_desolate.excerpt: Desolate
Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.
Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.
荒芜
当敌人附近%radius%范围内没有他们的友军时，幽鬼和她的幻象的攻击对他们造成额外纯粹伤害。
幽鬼自身的荒芜造成%bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%倍伤害，但是幽鬼的幻象不再触发荒芜。
伤害在幽鬼攻击前产生。
幽鬼的幻象继承荒芜。

spectre_haunt.excerpt:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。

鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。

子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。

冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

spectre_reality.excerpt: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.
Reality also casts Spectral Dagger on the illusion's target.
幽鬼占据如影随形或鬼影重重的幻象目标，并将其摧毁。
空降还会对幻象的目标施放幽鬼之刃。

spectre_shadow_step.excerpt:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。

子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

spectre_spectral_dagger.excerpt: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
幽鬼掷出一把匕首，留下一条暗影之径，对路径上的敌人造成伤害并减缓其移动速度。被匕首击中的单位移动时也会留下暗影之径。幽鬼在暗影之径上移速提升，并且可以无视地形移动。
在离开暗影之径后%dagger_grace_period%秒内碰撞体积依然为0，作为缓冲时间。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.excerpt: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
裂魂人获得移动速度和<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.excerpt: Charge of Darkness

Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
No other units will be hit by Greater Bash if it's not drafted as well. Target of Charge of Darkness will be stunned on impact even without Greater Bash.
暗影冲刺

裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。

途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
暗影冲刺的移动速度加成会在冲刺结束后逐渐消失。
裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。
暗影冲刺的移动速度加成提升%bonus_movement_speed%。
如果未同时拥有技能“巨力重击”则不会撞晕沿途单位，但冲刺目标还是会在到达时受到眩晕作用。

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.excerpt: Greater Bash
Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.

Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.

Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
巨力重击
攻击时有一定概率<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
过去%bonus_chance_duration%秒内对不止一名英雄触发了巨力重击就会使重击的概率提升。第一个英雄之后每个英雄都会使巨力重击的概率提升%bonus_chance_pct%%%。
不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。
技能征召中，与碎颅锤叠加。
击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.excerpt: Nether Strike

Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
Greater Bash must be drafted for stun.  Bonus damage still applies without Greater Bash.
Greatly increases knockback.
幽冥一击
裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
被幽冥一击击中的敌方目标受到友方的击退效果的移动距离更远。
裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。
必须同时拥有技能“巨力重击”才能造成眩晕效果。但额外伤害不需要技能“巨力重击”。
大幅提升击退效果。

storm_spirit_ball_lightning.excerpt: Ball Lightning

Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
球状闪电

风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

storm_spirit_electric_vortex.excerpt: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
Electric Vortex applies a debuff to the enemy that lasts for %enemy_overload_duration%s making their next attack target themself and trigger an Overload Charge.
Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
将一个敌人拖到风暴之灵所在位置的涡流。
电子涡流会对敌人施加%enemy_overload_duration%秒的负面效果，使敌人下次攻击会以自身为目标，并触发一次超负荷。
电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。

storm_spirit_overload.excerpt: Overload
Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.
Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
超负荷
施法时会产生电荷，在风暴之灵下次攻击时被释放，对附近敌人造成伤害并减速。
施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得%shard_activation_charges%次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多%shard_activation_duration%秒，或效果用尽。
使用物品不会触发超负荷。
超负荷效果不会叠加。

storm_spirit_static_remnant.excerpt: Static Remnant
Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.
残影
风暴之灵制造一个充满爆炸性能量的自身残影，会向目标地点走去，持续%abilityduration%秒。如果有人接近就会引爆造成伤害，残影持续%abilityduration%秒。
残影在技能施放%static_remnant_delay%秒后才能实体化。
残影在持续时间内拥有顺畅视野。
残影爆炸将伤害%static_remnant_damage_radius%码作用范围内的单位，但是触发范围是%static_remnant_radius%码。
可以对自身施放，这样会原地施放。

sven_great_cleave.excerpt: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。

sven_storm_bolt.excerpt: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

sven_warcry.excerpt: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.
Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.
提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供%base_barrier_amount%点<font color='#b94512'>物理伤害护盾</font>。
斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续%duration%秒。

techies_land_mines.excerpt: Proximity Mines

Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Also grants Minefield Sign ability.
感应地雷

埋布<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。
还会提供技能“雷区标识”。

techies_remote_mines.excerpt: Remote Mines
Plant an invisible explosive that will only detonate after a brief delay when triggered.  Does not damage buildings.
Increases damage and cast range.
Also grants Minefield Sign ability.
Grants 10 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
遥控炸弹
埋设一颗隐形的炸弹，只有在你的控制下经过简短的延迟才会引爆。爆炸对建筑无效。
提升伤害和施法距离。
还将提供技能“雷区标识”。
敌方英雄摧毁炸弹将获得10金钱。

techies_stasis_trap.excerpt: Stasis Trap
Plant an invisible trap that roots nearby enemy units instantly when triggered.
Increases cast range.
Stasis Traps destroy all other Stasis Traps in their area of effect when they detonate.
Stasis Traps are not triggered by invisible units.
Stasis Traps do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
静滞陷阱
埋设一个隐形的陷阱，当有敌方单位靠近时会马上自动触发，造成缠绕。
提升施法距离。
静滞陷阱触发后将摧毁作用范围内的其他静滞陷阱。
隐形单位不会触发静滞陷阱。
静滞陷阱不能阻止中立生物产生。

techies_sticky_bomb.excerpt: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
向目标区域抛出一个粘性炸弹。如果炸弹落在一个敌方英雄身旁，炸弹会粘上去，减缓其移动速度。数秒后炸弹会爆炸，对爆炸区域内造成伤害，并再次施加减速，持续%secondary_slow_duration%秒。

templar_assassin_inner_peace.excerpt: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.
原地不动且未受到伤害超过%time_until_meditation%秒后，圣堂刺客开始冥想，获得生命恢复和魔法恢复加成，冥想%time_until_max_bonus%秒后达到最大加成。

templar_assassin_psi_blades.excerpt: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.
圣堂刺客锋利的灵能之刃可以穿透敌人，对其正后方的敌方单位造成伤害，并且攻击距离得到提升。每对一个单位造成伤害后，飞溅伤害都会减少一定百分比。
飞溅伤害可以伤害隐身单位。
重击等攻击特效只对主目标有效。

templar_assassin_psionic_trap.excerpt: Psionic Trap

Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
灵能陷阱

圣堂刺客放下一个<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
现在陷阱引爆后还会<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>受到作用的敌人。
陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。

templar_assassin_refraction.excerpt: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).

圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。
生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。

terrorblade_conjure_image.excerpt: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
Conjure Image illusions always spawn at full health and cost health instead of mana.
Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.
创造一个恐怖利刃的幻象，可以攻击敌人造成伤害。
惑幻的幻象总是满血，但施放时消耗生命，而不是魔法。
惑幻产生的幻象在外观上与普通幻象不同。

terrorblade_dark_unity.excerpt: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
恐怖之刃控制的附近幻象拥有额外攻击伤害。
倒影的幻象也会受到作用。

terrorblade_demon_zeal.excerpt: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
施放需消耗恐怖利刃当前生命值的一部分，为恐怖利刃和他附近的幻象提供生命恢复、移动和攻击速度加成。不会影响倒影的幻象。魔化状态下无法施放，而且施放魔化会移除狂魔效果。

terrorblade_metamorphosis.excerpt: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.
恐怖利刃变换形态，化身成可怕的恶魔并具备远程攻击能力。任何恐怖利刃的幻象在%metamorph_aura_tooltip%范围内也将魔化。
近战或远程物品的冷却时间不同时将根据恐怖利刃在使用物品时处于远程或近战形态而定。

terrorblade_reflection.excerpt: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.
恐怖利刃映出目标区域内所有敌方英雄的黑暗倒影对其进行反制，目标在短时间内将被自身倒影攻击，移动速度和攻击速度都会降低。倒影为无敌状态。
无法以倒影的幻象为目标，并且幻象为无敌，减速效果被移除后幻象将被摧毁。
倒影只会攻击该技能指定的目标。

terrorblade_sunder.excerpt: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
There is no minimum health threshold for Sundered enemies.
Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
隔断恐怖利刃以及目标英雄的灵魂并将双方的当前血量百分比进行互换。交换后双方英雄的生命值必定在一定百分比以上。
魂断对敌人施放时没有最低生命值限制。
减益免疫的敌人不会被影响生命值。

terrorblade_terror_wave.excerpt: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
放出一道能量波，朝所有方向向外行进，击中敌方英雄将使其<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>并造成伤害，同时恐怖利刃短时间内获得魔化状态。

tidehunter_anchor_smash.excerpt: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

tidehunter_blubber.excerpt: Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than %damage_cleanse% damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Only damage from player owned sources is counted towards debuff removal.
The counter will reset if no player owned damage is taken for %damage_reset_interval% seconds.
潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过%damage_cleanse%点后还将移除负面的状态效果。会移除大部分负面效果，即使通常无法净化。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
只有玩家控制单位造成的伤害才会计算在移除负面状态的累计伤害中。
如果%damage_reset_interval%秒内没有受到来自玩家的伤害，伤害累计值将重置。

tidehunter_gush.excerpt: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

tidehunter_kraken_shell.excerpt:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.

加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
锚击效果下的敌方英雄阵亡会使海妖外壳获得永久伤害格挡。
不与提供伤害格挡的物品叠加。

tidehunter_leviathans_catch.excerpt:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得%fish_health_bonus%点最大生命值，%fish_attack_range%攻击距离和%fish_damage_block%额外伤害格挡。

潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加

tinker_defense_matrix.excerpt: Targets an allied unit, applying an all damage barrier to them that also provides Status Resistance.

When a Self-Defense Matrix barrier on Tinker is fully absorbed, he blinks in a random forward direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
以友方单位为目标，施加一个全伤害的护盾，并提供状态抗性。

在对自身施放的防御矩阵护盾被完全吸收后，修补匠会向前方的随机方向闪烁。

驱散类型：弱驱散

tinker_deploy_turrets.excerpt: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。

tinker_keen_teleport.excerpt: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.
持续施法 - 传送至友方建筑目标。2级可以传送至友方单位，3级可以传送至友方英雄。

tinker_laser.excerpt: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

tinker_march_of_the_machines.excerpt: March of the Machines
Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.
机械行军
征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。
机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。

tinker_rearm.excerpt: For abilities with charges, a single charge of the ability will be added everytime Rearm is cast.
CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
对于充能型技能，每次施放再装填可以恢复该技能一点能量。
持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。

tinker_warp_grenade.excerpt:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。

目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。

tiny_avalanche.excerpt: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

tiny_tree_grab.excerpt: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.
抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

treant_eyes_in_the_forest.excerpt: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.
树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。

treant_leech_seed.excerpt: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

Leech Seed can be ground targeted, planting a tree that heals allies and damages all enemies in the effect radius for the duration of the ability. Damage to creeps is reduced by %creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%. If the tree is cut down, it immediately re-grows again.

树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>和<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。
寄生种子可以对地施放，种下一棵树，在技能的持续时间内治疗作用范围内的友军并对敌人造成伤害。对非英雄单位的伤害和治疗均减少%creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%。树被砍掉会立刻长回来。

treant_natures_grasp.excerpt: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.
朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。

treant_natures_guise.excerpt: Nature's Guise

Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.
自然蔽护
只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。

troll_warlord_battle_trance.excerpt: Battle Trance

Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes %attack_speed_share_percent%%% of the attack speed bonus.
Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
战斗专注
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 \n\n驱散类型：弱驱散
战斗专注期间巨魔战将的热血战魂叠加层数上限变高，而且没有攻击速度上限。战斗专注为友方英雄提供%attack_speed_share_percent%%%攻击速度加成。
巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。

troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.excerpt:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。

远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。

troll_warlord_fervor.excerpt: Fervor
With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.

Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
热血战魂
当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
近战形态下热血战魂的叠加效果提供护甲。
巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。

troll_warlord_switch_stance.excerpt:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.

Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.

巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至%base_attack_time%。

巨魔战将每拥有%attack_speed_interval%攻击速度加成获得%armor_per_interval%点护甲。

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee.excerpt: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。

旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。

驱散类型：弱驱散

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.excerpt: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.

Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
旋风飞斧（远程）
巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。

旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。

驱散类型：弱驱散
无法作用于肉山。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

tusk_drinking_buddies.excerpt: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.
巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。
如果巨牙海民和目标友军相距在%min_distance%距离以内，就不会拉动他们。

tusk_ice_shards.excerpt: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
巨牙海民将数块寒冰碎片压缩成蕴含冰冻能量的冰球，对所有接触到冰球的敌人造成伤害。冰球到达目标地点时会产生一个障碍物，持续%shard_duration%秒。
将创造不可通行的障碍。

tusk_snowball.excerpt: Snowball

Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.
雪球
巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间都会得到提升。
雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。

tusk_walrus_kick.excerpt: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.
将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域%search_radius%范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少%creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

tusk_walrus_punch.excerpt: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
巨牙海民为他强力的海象神拳做好准备，下一次攻击将会造成额外伤害并暴击，同时将目标打到半空中。
海象神拳！拥有克敌机先效果。

undying_ceaseless_dirge.excerpt: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。

undying_decay.excerpt: Decay
Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.
Increases strength steal.
腐朽
不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。
提升力量窃取。

undying_flesh_golem.excerpt: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.
不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。
变身为血肉傀儡后，每次攻击会产生一个僵尸。

undying_soul_rip.excerpt: Soul Rip
Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
Casting Soul Rip on allies increases their Strength by a percentage of Undying's Strength.
Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
噬魂
不朽尸王从附近的所有单位身上扯出生命力，并使用它<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>队友或伤害敌人。可以使用噬魂<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>墓碑。
对友军施放噬魂会使他们的力量提升，数值为不朽尸王力量的一定百分比。
可以治疗墓碑，但是不能治疗或伤害其他建筑。
不会扯出隐身单位、无敌单位、战争迷雾内单位或减益免疫敌人的生命力。
可以扯出减益免疫友军，包括僵尸的生命力。

undying_tombstone.excerpt: Tombstone

Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.

Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.
墓碑
在目标位置召唤一座墓碑。墓碑会不断在其附近的每个敌方单位身边产生僵尸攻击他们。僵尸拥有死亡渴望技能，使他们的攻击带有减速效果，并且若目标的生命值低于一定百分比，僵尸的攻击和移动速度会提升。
墓碑免疫技能，但是可以被噬魂治疗。
僵尸和墓碑均免疫技能。
如果初始目标死亡或丢失视野，僵尸将会死亡。
墓碑可以对友方英雄施放，让他们躲进墓碑。进入墓碑的英雄%tombstone_bunker_cd%秒内无法离开，离开后同样的时间内无法再次进入。如果英雄在内时墓碑被摧毁，该英雄会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%tombstone_stun_penalty%秒。

ursa_earthshock.excerpt: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.
Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.
Requires Enrage to also be drafted to utilize Shard upgrade.
熊战士向前跳跃%hop_distance%距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速%abilityduration%秒。
震撼大地对击中的敌人施加%fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit%层怒意狂击。
同时拥有激怒才能使用魔晶升级效果。

ursa_fury_swipes.excerpt: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.
熊战士的利爪深深地撕裂敌人的伤口，对同一敌人连续攻击将造成更多伤害。如果同一个目标在%bonus_reset_time%秒内不受攻击，将失去额外伤害加成。
破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

vengefulspirit_command_aura.excerpt: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.

Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。

提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。

复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。
破坏会使攻击力光环失效。

vengefulspirit_magic_missile.excerpt: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.
Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并造成伤害。
魔法箭造成额外伤害，敌人每击杀一个非英雄单位为%damage_per_lasthit%点额外伤害。
可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。

vengefulspirit_nether_swap.excerpt: Nether Swap

Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
移形换位
与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。
对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.excerpt: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。

venomancer_noxious_plague.excerpt: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

venomancer_plague_ward.excerpt: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。

venomancer_poison_nova.excerpt: Venomancer emits a spreading ring of poison that does nonlethal damage over time to enemy units. Damage done is a base amount plus a percentage of the target's max health.
Venomancer emits a spreading ring of poison that does nonlethal damage over time to enemy units. Damage done is a base amount plus a percentage of the target's max health.

venomancer_poison_sting.excerpt: Poison Sting
Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.
Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
毒刺
剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.
毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。

venomancer_sepsis.excerpt: Septic Shock
Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.
Plague Wards also deal Septic Shock damage based on their attack damage.
Increases base damage per debuff.
Break only disables the bonus damage for Venomancer's attacks.
脓毒休克
剧毒术士的攻击会根据目标身上拥有的负面效果数量造成额外伤害。额外伤害为魔法伤害。只会计算来自剧毒术士或他的瘟疫守卫的负面效果。
瘟疫守卫还会根据他们的攻击力造成脓毒休克的伤害。
提升每个负面状态提供的基础伤害。
破坏只会使剧毒术士攻击的额外伤害失效。

venomancer_venomous_gale.excerpt: Venomous Gale

Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.
Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.
瘴气
沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。
瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。

viper_nethertoxin.excerpt: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。

viper_nose_dive.excerpt: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。

viper_poison_attack.excerpt: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。
提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.excerpt: Gravekeeper's Cloak

Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.

Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
陵卫斗篷

维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。

维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。
每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

visage_silent_as_the_grave.excerpt: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

visage_soul_assumption.excerpt: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.

Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.
Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过%damage_limit%点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
灵魂超度击杀时每点灵魂能量会提供%bonus_soul_charge_gold%金，最高为%bonus_gold_max_tooltip%金。击杀非英雄时获得的金钱有所减少。灵魂超度作用于敌方英雄后%gold_grace_period_hero%秒内英雄阵亡也会获得金钱。
能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于%damage_min%点小于%damage_max%点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。

visage_summon_familiars.excerpt: Summon Familiars

Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.\n\nThe ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
召唤佣兽

召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。\n\n技能可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。

佣兽会攻击维萨吉最后尝试攻击的目标，如果目标超出了维萨吉的攻击距离，或者维萨吉下达了取消当前动作或固守原地的命令后，佣兽会返回。

技能可以设为自动施法，命令佣兽回到维萨吉身旁，在技能关闭前不会离开。
技能可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。
技能可以设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。
施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

void_spirit_aether_remnant.excerpt: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.

Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

void_spirit_astral_step.excerpt: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成%pop_damage_delay%秒减速，然后引爆。
太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

void_spirit_dissimilate.excerpt: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.

Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.
虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。
退出异化时，距离虚无之灵最远的%aether_remnant_count%个灵扉处会产生残阴。如果在中央的灵扉重组则没有效果。残阴会面朝中央的灵扉，牵引时间和伤害降低。

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.excerpt: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.
Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性<font color='#b94512'>护盾</font>之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，<font color='#b94512'>护盾</font>的伤害吸收量都会提升。
共鸣脉冲会产生更强的全伤害护盾，而不是物理伤害护盾。
共鸣脉冲可以<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>敌人，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

void_spirit_symmetry.excerpt: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.
虚无之灵对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时获得物理伤害护盾。

warlock_eldritch_summoning.excerpt: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.

Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
魔童被敌方英雄击杀时不再爆炸。
只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

warlock_golem_permanent_immolation.excerpt: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.
地狱火燃烧它周围的敌方单位，每秒造成伤害。

warlock_rain_of_chaos.excerpt: Chaotic Offering

Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
混乱之祭
从深渊召唤一个地狱火，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
召唤%number_of_golems_scepter%个地狱火。
混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。
该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

warlock_shadow_word.excerpt: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。目标单位也会被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

warlock_upheaval.excerpt: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

weaver_geminate_attack.excerpt: Geminate Attack
Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.
连击
允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。
第二次攻击将在编织者第一次攻击的%delay%秒后发出，并且没有距离限制。
额外伤害仅对连击的攻击有效，初始攻击没有额外伤害。
连击还会击中虫群附着目标%shard_beetle_search_range%范围内的单位。

weaver_the_swarm.excerpt: The Swarm
Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.
When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.
虫群
编织者放出%count%只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
虫群的甲虫攻击英雄时编织者会获得经验。
甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的%destroy_attacks%次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。

weaver_threads_of_fate.excerpt: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们%thread_setup_distance%范围内停留达到%thread_setup_time%秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

weaver_time_lapse.excerpt: Time Lapse
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.
时光倒流
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。\n\n驱散类型：强驱散
能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

windrunner_focusfire.excerpt: Focus Fire

Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.

Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.
Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
集中火力
风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
集中火力不再需要施法目标，而是对风行者攻击距离 + %bonus_range%范围内的随机敌人发动攻击。每秒发动固定次数的攻击，并且每4箭才会击中一次同个敌人。以英雄优先。
下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

windrunner_powershot.excerpt: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
