Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.
Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
被击中的敌方英雄血量低于临界值就会被秒杀。秒杀血量是基于箭矢的威力。
强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

windrunner_shackleshot.excerpt: Shackleshot
Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.
This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
束缚击
将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
束缚击会对目标单位身后的所有单位和树木施加，每个额外束缚的单位和树木都会使风行者获得攻击力加成。非英雄单位和树木提供的攻击力加成较少。
该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

windrunner_tailwind.excerpt: Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.\n\nPassively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。\n\n被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

windrunner_windrun.excerpt: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。

winter_wyvern_accelerated_learning.excerpt: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.excerpt: Arctic Burn

Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
严寒烧灼
寒冬飞龙乘着一股极地寒风扶摇而上，移动将无视地形，每次攻击都将呼出逼人的寒气。高飞时，她的攻击距离更远，攻击弹道速度也更快，被攻击的敌人在寒意作用下，移动速度会被减缓，同时每秒损失%percent_damage%%%当前生命值。
严寒烧灼变成开关型技能，开启后每秒消耗一定量魔法。提升寒冬飞龙的移动速度。
本技能无法作用于肉山。
寒冬飞龙的攻击前摇降低至%attack_point%秒。
严寒烧灼的持续伤害和减速可以被驱散。

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.excerpt: Cold Embrace
Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.

Cold Embrace can be cast on buildings. Does not heal buildings. Allied units and buildings gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon. Duration is paused if the building is protected by both Glyph of Fortification and Cold Embrace.
Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
Shard upgrade requires also drafting Splinter Blast.
极寒之拥
将队友封入一个冰茧中，使其被冻在原地并恢复生命值，恢复数值为基础数值加上最大生命值的一定比例。冰茧将阻隔一切物理伤害。
极寒之拥可以对建筑施放。不会治疗建筑。冰茧中的友方单位和建筑在冰茧解冻后获得攻击力加成。如果建筑同时处于极寒之拥和防御符文的作用，极寒之拥的持续时间会暂停。
冷却时间减少%shard_cooldown_reduction%秒。友方单位从冰茧解冻后获得额外攻击力。
魔晶升级需要同时拥有碎裂冲击。

winter_wyvern_eldwurm_scholar.excerpt: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within %xp_gain_range% of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to %mana_to_xp_percentage%%% of the ultimate's manacost.
When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within %xp_gain_range% of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to %mana_to_xp_percentage%%% of the ultimate's manacost.

winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda.excerpt: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption.
寒冬飞龙获得物品“古龙诗集”，可以消耗，使一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级，另外寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时相应数值的%tooltip_int_pct%%%。

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.excerpt: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.
向一个单位发射一团易碎的冰球。冰球一击中目标就会碎裂，而目标单位将不会受到任何效果，但是附近%split_radius%基础范围内敌人都将因碎片的冲击受到伤害，并且移动速度减缓%movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%。
主弹道无法被躲避，而且不能以寒冬飞龙自身为目标。

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.excerpt: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.
寒冬飞龙驱散一个敌方目标并将其冻在原地，附近的其他敌人将受到癫狂诅咒，对冻住的队友进行攻击，而且攻击速度得到提升。冻住的目标和被诅咒攻击队友的敌人不会受到任何来自敌方的伤害，不过寒冬飞龙或她控制的单位造成的伤害除外。敌方英雄进入施放后的诅咒范围内会增加诅咒的持续时间。
如果目标被其队友击杀，击杀者将仍是寒冰飞龙。
无视主目标的减益免疫状态，但是对目标周围的减益免疫队友无效。

wisp_overcharge.excerpt: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.
艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。
过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得攻击速度和技能增强。
过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得护甲和魔法抗性。

wisp_spirits.excerpt: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。
每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。

wisp_tether.excerpt: Tether

Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.
If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
羁绊
将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复%damage_to_heal%%%造成伤害。
如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。

witch_doctor_death_ward.excerpt: Death Ward
CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
死亡守卫
持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
死亡守卫同时攻击%initial_target_count%个目标，但伤害降低。次级目标受到%secondary_attack_damage_pct%%%伤害。
死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。
死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。

witch_doctor_maledict.excerpt: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。
受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.excerpt: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
麻痹药剂每次弹跳造成额外伤害。
目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.excerpt: Voodoo Restoration
Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
巫毒疗法
巫医集中魔力<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
巫毒疗法对敌人造成伤害，只会治疗巫医自身。
治疗间隔为%heal_interval%秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。

zuus_arc_lightning.excerpt: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
Shard: Lightning Hands is hidden in the ability panel when Shard is acquired, but can be enabled and disabled by activating the Alternate Cast on Arc Lightning.
释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
魔晶：获得魔晶后霹雳之手不会在技能栏中显示，但是弧形闪电切换多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）可以启用或禁用该效果。

zuus_lightning_bolt.excerpt: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.
召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

zuus_lightning_hands.excerpt: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。

zuus_thundergods_wrath.excerpt: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.
Nimbus requires Lightning Bolt to be drafted for damage.
用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
从最低生命值的英雄开始，逐一对敌人造成伤害，最后是生命值最高的敌人。如果有敌人被这个技能击杀，那么接下来所有敌人受到的伤害都会增加。
雷云需要拥有雷击才能造成伤害。
